articleTitle: Underwater Sonar Image Classification with Small Samples Based on Parameter-based Transfer Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The research of underwater sonar image classification is helpful to the exploration and development of marine resources. However, there are relatively few studies on the classification of underwater sonar image with small samples. Aiming at the problem, a new classification method of sonar image is proposed based on parameter-based transfer learning and deep learning (named SonarNet). Firstly, a new classification network of sonar image (Global Average Pooling VGGNet, GAPVGG) is designed based on VGG16 network, and GAPVGG can solve the over-fitting problem caused by training VGG16 network directly with small sample sonar image. Compared with the original VGG16 network, the number of parameters of the GAPVGG network is reduced by nearly 90%. Then, according to the parameter-based transfer learning, the knowledge is transferred from the source domain to the target domain to solve the problem of insufficient sonar image samples. Finally, it is demonstrated from experiments that the proposed method is effective, and the classification accuracy of sonar image reaches 98.25%.

articleTitle: Hyperspectral Image Classification Based On Fuzzy Nonparallel Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Support vector machine has excellent classification performance, and also has a good performance in hyperspectral image classification. However, parallel decision classification planes are difficult to fully satisfy the distribution of real data. In order to solve this problem, some nonparallel support vector machines have been proposed. However, the real data still has the influence of noise, which makes the classification effect poor. This paper proposes a nonparallel support vector machine combined with fuzzy membership, which assigns different weights to different samples according to their importance. It is named Fuzzy Nonparallel Support Vector Machine, FNSVM. By analyzing the experimental results, it is shown that FNSVM achieves better classification results than SVM.

articleTitle: Substation One-Line Diagram Automatic Generation Based On Image Recongnition
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the development of smart grids, lots of technologies are applied to solve the problems of power systems. The substation one-line diagram automatic generation is the core of power systems. Currently, the traditional methods are not suitable for solving problems. In this paper, we introduce the newly deep learning technologies to generate substation one-line diagram automatically. Firstly, our algorithm adopts YOLOV3 method to detect symbols, which is a multiscale object detection algorithm, it is very effective for small objects like the Disconnector. Secondly, the PPOCR method is used to detect position and content of text, it can recognize various numbers and letters. At last, the Rooted Tree Algorithm and Hightower Algorithm are introduced to generate layout and topological relationship between symbols. Extensive experiments prove that our method obtains the best performance, the symbol recognition accuracy can reach 98%, and the text recognition accuracy can reach 97%, the accuracy of circuit diagram regeneration and construction is effectively improved.

articleTitle: An Improved Fog Concentration Detection Method for Waterway Based on FADE
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: .- The frequent occurrence of foggy weather greatly impacts the water transportation system, so it is essential to detect fog concentration. Therefore, we introduce and improve an approach of Fog Aware Density Evaluator (FADE) to specifically detect fog concentration in waterways. First, we test a series of fog-related features on the synthesized foggy waterway images. Second, we propose a novel set of features with the addition of two new ones, namely color value in HSV color space, and gray standard deviation. Finally, based on the feature set, the fog concentration of the image patch and the whole image can be obtained using our proposed method, and the fog concentration distribution map can be derived from the fog concentration of image patches. Experimental results show that the method has higher accuracy than FADE in detecting the whole fog concentration of waterway images.

articleTitle: Multi-sensor track fusion algorithm research and simulation analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Target tracking is extremely important in the military field. In multi-sensor data fusion processing, track fusion techniques are required to make the target position information more accurate and reliable. In this paper, the target motion uses uniform and uniformly accelerated motion models, and the smoothing of the motion trajectory uses Kalman filtering. In this paper, Convex combination fusion algorithm, covariance weighted fusion algorithm and adaptive fusion algorithm are used to fuse the track data, and analyze the performance of these three algorithms with fusion trajectory, root mean square error of fusion comparison and algorithm time complexity comparison. The simulation results show that all three algorithms can extract useful information from the track data and improve the target tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of SD-WAN Technology in Power Communication Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power communication network and the increasing demand for communication, the conventional wide area network(W AN) cannot meet the communication needs of long-distance power communication networking any longer. In order to eliminate the pain points of high networking costs and complex protocols, SD-WAN formed by applying the SDN technology in the WAN is flexible and reliable, which not only can establish a virtual communication channel, but also can be used as an emergency link to quickly restore services. In this paper, the application of SD- WAN in the scenarios with lack of power communication resources is studied, and a secure public network resource application device is developed on the basis of the SD-WAN technology, and the technical solution for the hybrid networking of optical fiber network and public network is optimized. This device can provide a broadband communication link in emergency situations, improving the availability and reliability of the power communication network.

articleTitle: Task Scheduling Model of Edge Computing for AI Flow Computing in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the development of intelligent applications of the Internet of things, the sharp increase of data scale and the improvement of computational model complexity in the edge computing environment put forward higher requirements for the performance of edge computing. Reasonably optimizing the scheduling of AI data intensive computing tasks can greatly improve the overall performance of edge computing. Therefore, a novel particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to realize task scheduling in edge computing environment by calculating task scheduling to optimize task execution time and scheduling cost. Improve the speed formula of particle swarm optimization algorithm to improve the convergence speed and row performance of the algorithm. Finally, on the Cloudsim simulation platform, the proposed particle group algorithm LK-PSO was compared with the other four benchmark algorithms. The results showed that the method task scheduling cost and execution time were effectively optimized. This method can effectively improve the resource utilization rate of marginal computing and improve the efficiency of marginal computing power.

articleTitle: Design of an Underwater Autonomous Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This paper mainly designs and manufactures an underwater autonomous inspection robot (UAIR), including mechanical structure, circuit control and visual recognition. Using computer-aided modeling and design software, combined with the theoretical knowledge of fluid dynamics, the mechanical structure of UAIR is optimized to prolong the underwater working time. The circuit module includes the design of the MPU and the design of the control algorithm. Through the sensor to monitor the trajectory and posture of the robot under the water, the motion controller is designed by using the PID principle to realize the dynamic adjustment of the robot and achieve the purpose of autonomous operation. Based on Yolov5 model, an end-to-end image deblurring scheme is proposed, and multi-scale restoration strategy is used to improve the accuracy of robot object recognition. Finally, the UAIR can operate stably within 20 meters underwater, and the autonomous control and remote control modes can be switched flexibly, with a recognition accuracy of 96%.

articleTitle: Underwater Image Enhancement Based on Light Attenuation Prior and Dual-Image Multi-Scale Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The focus of this work is solving the degradation of underwater images. Different from images taken on land, underwater images suffer from color bias and fuzzy details due to absorption and scattering. In order to solve the above problems of underwater images, we propose a novel method called LAPF, which includes two stages of restoration and dual-image multi-scale fusion. Restoration based on underwater light attenuation prior can initially restore the details of the underwater image by building a scene depth estimation model. Coupled with the use of image fusion, obtain the contrast-enhanced picture and color-corrected picture as fusion inputs, and calculate the normalized weight maps to add detail. Carrying out multi-scale decomposition and fusion of these two parts, successfully further enhance the contrast while realizing the color correction. Experimental results on a variety of underwater images show the power of the method proposed in this paper, which achieves good results in both subjective visual perception and objective quality evaluation parameters.

articleTitle: Lateral Stability Control of Four-Wheel-Drive Vehicle Based on Coordinated Control of Torque Distribution and Vehicle Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, a 14-degree-of-freedom whole-vehicle model and a sliding-mode controller considering the suspension load transfer and dynamic characteristics are designed for the lateral stability control problem of a distributed drive vehicle, and the results of this lateral stability controller are analyzed. The upper layer calculates the target center-of-mass lateral deflection angle and the target transverse moment based on the 14-degree-of-freedom vehicle model; the lower layer calculates the target transverse moment based on the center-of-mass lateral deflection angle and the target transverse moment, so as to control the output torque of the wheel motor to improve the lateral stability of the vehicle. In order to verify the reliability and effectiveness of the vehicle model and controller, a joint simulation platform is built in this paper. The simulation results show that the designed distributed vehicle dynamics model can well reflect the lateral performance of the vehicle, and the lateral stability controller based on the sliding mode control has greatly improved the lateral stability of the vehicle and reduced the lateral displacement of the vehicle by 23%.

articleTitle: Power Control Research for Device-to-Device Wireless Network Underlying Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that co-channel interference leads to decrease of system data throughput when reusing cellular user spectrum resources, a D2D communication link power control method combined with reinforcement learning SARSA algorithm is proposed. Joint RL Model-free control and on-policy characteristics of actions consistent with evaluation strategies in SARSA. The simulation results show that it can significantly reduce average transmission power in the communication process and effectively improve the data throughput.

articleTitle: A Prufer-leaf Coding Genetic Algorithm For Bayesian Network Structure Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: All Bayesian network is a probabilistic graph model which is used to describe the causal distribution among variables and has been widely used in many fields. While Bayesian network structure learning is the core of Bayesian network research, it is also an NP-hard problem. This paper draws on the idea of Prufer encoding/decoding, combines genetic algorithm and mutual information theory, and proposes a genetic algorithm based on improved Prufer-Leaf coding to solve the learning optimization problem of Bayesian network structures. Finally, the superiority of the algorithm in learning Bayesian network structure is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: The Exploration of Teaching Reform of Virtual Reality Technology in Applied Linguistics Courses
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Using virtual reality technology in applied linguistics courses can achieve a high degree of integration of applied linguistics courses and teaching practices. By teaching and exercising in in virtual reality technology, students can experience a variety of teaching environments and teaching scenarios, recognize how to respond and solve in various teaching situations, increase teaching experience in virtual reality, accumulate teaching experience, truly deal with problems in teaching, and improve the practical ability of education and teaching.

articleTitle: Intelligent Virtual Wardrobe System Based on Android
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The popularity of smart phones has greatly changed people's lifestyles, and users' demands for mobile application services are becoming more and more diverse, such as people's daily clothing matching, clothes shopping, etc. This paper aims to develop an intelligent virtual wardrobe system based on Android, which has the functions of intelligent clothing recommendation and stereoscopic display. Users can freely choose clothes and preview the effect through the system. At the same time, the system will also recommend relevant collocations for users according to the weather and other conditions. The system introduces virtual reality technology into the mobile wardrobe to enhance the user experience.

articleTitle: End-to-end speaker diarization of Tibetan based on BLSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: At present, the research on speaker diarization mainly focuses on English. However, there are few studies on speaker diarization of Tibetan. Therefore, this paper takes Tibetan speech as the research goal, and proposes a new method for end-to-end speaker diarization of Tibetan based on BLSTM. The method uses an end-to-end architecture, and the model uses a single neural network, which can directly output the label classification results of Tibetan speakers. Experimental results show that our method can solve the speech overlap problem of Tibetan speakers, and the proposed method is evaluated on the simulated mixed speech of Tibetan. The DER of this method is 15.33%.

articleTitle: An Improved Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency Method Solving Multi-Text Label Problem
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the advent of the Internet era, people can express their likes and feelings without leaving home. A large amount of text data has also emerged, such as microblog comments, movie reviews, news reports and other data. Accurate tagging of text is a key step in quickly finding the text data that they are interested in. Since the frequency of words in the text message varies, the more frequency words may not be suitable for the text label, but fewer frequency words are better suited to the content of the text. This work considers how to avoid the interference of common words and extract tags more accurately. A new solution method called Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency and K-Nearest Neighbor combined to extract multi-text tags are proposed to solve it. The feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified by an example - Douban film review.

articleTitle: Review of Wearable Computing Technology: Core Technologies, Typical Systems and Research Trends
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Wearable computing is a new type of mobile computing system, which has positive applications in sports, health, military, pension and other fields, and has a profound impact on the future development. In order to better understand the development and research status of wearable computing, this paper combs all aspects of wearable system. Firstly, the basic information of wearable computing is introduced, then the core technologies and typical systems of wearable computing are summarized, and finally the future development of this field is prospected. The research of this paper has reference value for grasping the relevant knowledge and future development trend of wearable computing.

articleTitle: Application of Mask R-CNN in defect detection of industrial filter cloth
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Industrial filter cloth will produce stains and defects in the production process, which will have a certain impact on the sales of filter cloth. Traditional filter cloth manufacturers rely on manual classification of defect types. Due to human subjectivity and visual fatigue, classification errors and omissions will occur. To solve this problem, this paper uses Mask R-CNN convolutional neural network model to classify and identify filter cloth defects. In this paper, 3600 industrial filter cloth images are collected and preprocessed. The images are expanded to 12000 images. The network is trained by combining the improved feature pyramid network (FPN) algorithm. The results show that the combination of resnet101 model as the backbone network has the best application effect.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Reform Method of Sensor Principle and Application under the Background of “Internet+”
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at improving the teaching quality and closely combining with the teaching reform foundation of Sensor Principle and Application, the teachers of the project group studied the teaching reform methods of the course. In this paper, it is explored and practiced the “open and independent, production-education integration” teaching method based on the “Internet+ background”, summarized the characteristics of the teaching method in practice, and discussed the specific organizational form. Teachers have explored, practiced and improved the overall organic system of teaching method, and also cultivated students' independent learning methods and habits, with good practical results.

articleTitle: An Improvement Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Decomposition and Grid-based Pareto Dominance for Many-objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, an better evolutionary algorithm based on decomposition and grid-based Pareto dominance (MOEA/DG) is proposed to work out many-objective optimization problems. The main goal is to heighten the convergence and diversity by generating good offspring with a good selection strategy. To be specific, a selection method based on decomposition and grid-based Pareto dominance is given to equilibrate exploration and exploitation. Moreover, the non-dominated solutions are kept on file external and a new diversity strategy is used to maintain diversity. The MOEA/DG compares with several advanced and excellent algorithms on many-objective benchmark functions, the experimental data verify that the algorithm put forward has good effects on most issues.

articleTitle: Design and study of plasma-activated water mist disinfection equipment based on DBD
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Under the background of the normalization of epidemic prevention and control, traditional disinfection methods have many problems, such as raw material consumption, stimulating the human body, environmental pollution, and so on. The new disinfection technology has great application and development space. Plasma medicine, as a representative of the emerging interdisciplinary field, has received great attention. Plasma contains a variety of highly active components, which can effectively kill pathogenic microorganisms. It has the advantages of no chemical residue, safe operation, and environmental safety. On this basis, a plasma-activated water mist (PAWM) technology based on dielectric barrier discharges (DBD) came into being. The large area/volume ratio of micron droplets promoted the transformation of gaseous short-life reactive oxygen-nitrogen ions into liquid active particles, which had the advantages of high activity, large treatment area, and low cost. In this paper, the plasma-activated water mist was used as the core technology to explore efficient, environmentally friendly, convenient disinfection equipment that can directly act on the living body, and provide a scientific basis and reference for the research on epidemic prevention and control.

articleTitle: Application of 3D Scanning Technique in the Grottoes Protection
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The strategy for invigorating China through The science and The education gradually sprang up in the background of the rapid development of digital and technology, Especially, the protection of cultural heritage by digital technology is very useful. The paper applies 3D scanning technology to the grottoes protection, to analyzes the application and function of digital technology in cultural heritage, and verifies the operation method. The purpose is to promote the inheritance and promotion of Traditional Chinese culture.

articleTitle: Research on the application of artificial intelligence in medical imaging diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This paper first expounds the research status for artificial intelligence technology in medical imaging diagnosis, and illustrates the importance of computer-aided diagnosis with examples; Secondly, the current bottlenecks in the development of computer-aided diagnosis technology are analyzed in detail from the aspects of technology, industry and application; Finally, based on the previous analysis, the paper puts forward some suggestions on how to better use artificial intelligence technology in medical imaging diagnosis with reference to the current actual situations.

articleTitle: A Preliminary Study on the Development and Application of Digital Twin Landscape Architectures in the Context of Smart City
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Every industry transformation and upgrading is often accompanied by fission caused by the collision of traditional methods and new era trends. Following that the concept of smart city was formally proposed in 2008, the European Union accurately located their focus about city on architecture and put forward the initiative of “Construction Industry 4.0: a once-in-a-generation opportunity” to the world for the first time <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup> in 2017; meanwhile, Glodon Company Limited proposed a Digital Building ecology System, closely responding to the development trend of smart earth in the same year. Under the dynamic changes of the international situation, only by keeping up with the situation can we make breakthroughs, and only by following the trend can we gain new knowledge. Nowadays, all states are actively preparing for the digital age, and our country has raised the task of smart city to be a national-level object, and taken it as an important carrier for building a Digital China. In the future, the digital smart industry will be presented in more stages and endowed with infinite prospects. Therefore, this paper intends to deduce the future trend of landscape architecture from the development trend in the context of smart city. Relying on digital twin, it proposes the digital twin landscape architecture featured as new, visualized, online, and intelligent, in which an appropriate system serves smart city, in the context of digital architecture, to provide a higher-quality, diverse and inclusive development approach for the landscape architecture field and better serves users.

articleTitle: Progress on Geographic Cellular Automata Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Rapid land development has caused a series of land use problems, such as low utilization rate of land, imbalance of urban land structure ratio as well as rapid urban expansion, and intensified contradiction of land supply and demand. The rational implementation of land use planning can alleviate these problems to a certain extent. With the development of computer science, it has become inevitable to apply computer technology to explore land use change mechanisms and implement land use planning rationally. Land use is a complex system interacted by natural and socioeconomic factors, and the cellular automata model is a powerful tool to explore complex systems. The cellular automata model can express the spatial structure and patterns of complex systems and is widely used in land use change simulation and future urban scenario prediction, which can be an effective tool for spatial exploration in designing land use planning schemes. This paper introduces the cellular automata model and its transformation rules in land use change research, reviews the progress of cellular automata model research in the field of geography and proposes suggestions for future research work.

articleTitle: Research on ultra-high power laser curing based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of large temperature error in the melting and clarifying process of borosilicate glass in the process of vitrification of high-level waste liquid with 100 kW fiber laser, a temperature control algorithm based on RBF neural network PID was proposed. The vitrification of borosilicate glass is a nonlinear, time-lag and large inertia process. Conventional manual control and PID control cannot meet the temperature control requirements during the vitrification of borosilicate glass. In this paper, a three-layer RBF neural network model is established, and the PID parameters are adjusted online by using the adaptability of the RBF neural network. The simulation results show that compared with manual control and PID control, the RBF neural network PID control has faster adjustment speed, smaller overshoot and stronger self-adaptation, and effectively reduces the temperature error during glass curing., improving the robustness of the system, resulting in higher waste containment and thermal efficiency.

articleTitle: Promoting Students' Programming Skills in Constructions for Teaching Materials and Curriculums: Experiments for Comprehensive Application of Programming Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The goal for experiments for programming languages is to polish students' programming skills solving problems by programming languages. Programming contests are contests solving problems by programming. A programming language experiment based on “solving problems by programming” consists of the related knowledge background for programming languages and methods, programming contest problems and their analysis and solutions. The paper specifies experiments for programming languages based on “solving problems by programming”: the comprehensive application of programming methods. These experiments enlighten students to solve a problem by programming through comprehensively applying programming methods: offline method, binary search, and real precision processing.

articleTitle: Study of Situation Assessment Model and Perceptual Prediction of Smart Grid Network Using Situation Awareness Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: To solve the problems in power grid dispatching monitoring and evaluation, the situation assessment model and perceptual prediction of smart grid network using situation awareness technology through big data are analyzed. The alarm information of intelligent alarm collection and dispatching automation system is collected to design the overall structure of intelligent grid network situation. The grid risk assessment model based on line overload risk, chain fault risk and failure component risk is designed. The perceptual results of different models are analyzed by examples. This method can describe the development of power grid network security situation with high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Practice And Exploration Of Auricular Therapy Teaching Based On VR Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Auricular therapy is a characteristic technique of acupuncture in Chinese medicine and is an important part of traditional Chinese medicine. However, the existing research results on auricular therapy, including auricular point localization and auricular stimulation response pathways, generally lack visualization, which greatly limits the promotion, teaching, and research of auricular therapy. Therefore, through technological innovation, the use of the latest 3D visualization technology such as VR can not only promote the propagation of auricular therapy, but also provide an intuitive and visible digital dynamic display for clinical training and teaching of auricular pivot adjustment to fill the gap in auricular education. The design of auricular therapy teaching based on VR platform can promote the diversification of auricular teaching in practice, and also effectively improve students' understanding of auricular knowledge points.

articleTitle: Resource Virtualization in Edge Computing: A Review
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In the era of the Internet of Everything, edge computing is developing rapidly. Due to the heterogeneous and decentralized distribution of resources, virtualization technology is generally used to integrate and isolate various physical resources in the edge computing environment in order to shield the differences in resources. Firstly, this paper introduces the concept of edge computing and the application status of edge computing. Then, it describes two virtualization technologies in edge computing, and discusses the current research status of these two virtualization technologies. Finally, the research direction of resource virtualization in edge computing we proposes.

articleTitle: A Blockchain Sharing Model of Seafarers Electronic Medical Certificate
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In the process of issuance, administration, and verification of traditional seafarers' medical certificate, there are problems such as simple fraud, easy damage, inconvenience to carry, and high management cost. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposed a blockchain sharing model of Seafarers Electronic Medical Certificate (SEMC). Firstly, a practical data structure of electronic medical certificate storage for seafarers is designed, which realizes that the data related to seafarers' electronic medical certificate is put away within the consortium chain and cannot be tampered with, hence ensuring the traceability and security of electronic medical certificate information of seafarers. Then, the ES search engine is constructed to realize precise and proficient inquiry of indicated watchwords. Through model testing and performance analysis, the effectiveness of the model in realizing SEMC quick sharing among multi-user is verified.

articleTitle: Design of water treatment units based on plasma technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Due to the impact of the COVID-19 epidemic in recent years, Chinese residents have gradually increased their awareness of sterilization and disinfection, but in the field of residential food sterilization and disinfection, a safe and reliable method has not been found.. To solve the problem of residents in food sterilization disinfection, the project is put forward using the low temperature plasma technology, developed a set of disinfection of water treatment system, the system is the use of high pressure low temperature plasma discharge technology, and then the gas dissolved in the water, make ordinary water has the effect of sterilization, then use the activated water cleaning ingredients. Finally, the food material cleaned with activated water can be sterilized and safe to eat.

articleTitle: Design of augmented reality-based visualization system for server room operation and maintenance
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In traditional communication room operation and maintenance operations, due to incomplete communication equipment operation and maintenance information and inexperienced technical skills personnel, problem solving often requires consulting operation manuals or inviting experts to the site for diagnosis and guidance, which greatly limits the efficiency of operation and maintenance. The paper combines augmented reality (AR) technology to design an operation and maintenance visualization system for server rooms. When the operation and maintenance personnel wear AR devices to recognize the images of the signage of the server room, they can interact with the virtual components and achieve the functions of the operation and maintenance inspection assistance. The system can run smoothly with low hardware requirement and simple deployment, and in the verification experiment of augmented reality hologram stability, the system can keep the error at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0=5{\%}$</tex> when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0^{\circ}\sim 360^{\circ}$</tex> and distance within 2m, which proves the practicality of the method in the maintenance process of the server room for operators.

articleTitle: Analysis and Forecast of Influencing Factors on House Prices Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Taking Shenzhen as an example, based on the relevant quantitative data affecting commercial house prices in Shenzhen from 2001 to 2020, the main factors affecting commercial house prices in Shenzhen were screened out by using Lasso regression, and grey prediction model was constructed by using the data passing the grade ratio test to predict the data of each variable in the next 5 years. Afterwards, a Support Vector Regression model was constructed to predict the trend of commercial house prices of Shenzhen based on the values of each variable from 2001 to 2025. The results of the study show that the main influencing factors of Shenzhen commercial house prices are the sales area of residential commercial housing, the purchase and sale prices of second-hand houses, etc. The growth of commercial house prices in Shenzhen from 2021 to 2025 is greater and faster compared to previous years. The analysis of the influencing factors and trends of Shenzhen's commercial house prices can provide reasonable policy suggestions for the development of the real estate industry and construction of long-term regulation of real estate in the future.

articleTitle: Study on energy supplement strategy of carbon dioxide huff and puff in horizontal well of tight oil sandstone reservoir
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Zoilfield belongs to low porosity and low permeability reservoir. The production of natural energy in the early stage of horizontal well development is low. It can be deduced that the formation energy is insufficient which is difficult to establish effective displacement in water injection development. The Z1 horizontal well test in Z oilfield was selected to carry out the carbon dioxide huff and puff energy supplement test with the goal of improving the development effect of low-yield horizontal wells and enhancing oil recovery. Through relevant empirical formulas and numerical simulation, the parameters such as throughput timing, gas injection rate, gas injection rate, soaking time and production flow pressure of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> huff and puff are optimized. The index prediction and economic evaluation were carried out, and the coincidence rate of numerical simulation was 96 %. Provide technical reference for economic and effective development of similar reservoirs.

articleTitle: Modeling and Analysis of Interconnected Hydro-Pneumatic Suspension System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Based on the oil source system, hydraulic pump accumulator, electro-hydraulic proportional valve, and other components, the model of the suspension hydraulic system is established and designed by analyzing the principle and relationship of each component or subsystem of the suspension hydraulic system. The hydraulic interconnected suspension system with attitude adjustment function is designed, and its structural composition and the function of each component are analyzed. The control analysis of different actions of hydraulic interconnected suspension such as vehicle roll, single axle lifting, and single wheel locking is carried out. Combined with an application example of oil piping structure analysis of vehicle interconnected suspension leveling system, the oil flow in the process of controlling vehicle attitude change and the working state setting of each hydraulic component are given. To realize different action control of the vehicle body, the power-on timing table of each solenoid valve and its electromagnet in the controlled state is designed based on electric drive.

articleTitle: Feature Recognition and Forming Measurement of Weld Surface Based on Laser Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The application of robot welding technology promotes the upgrading of construction machinery products. In the process of lap joint welding, due to the influence of gap, there will be insufficient weld surface reinforcement, which directly affects the weld quality. The traditional surface reinforcement measurement method can not meet the requirements of detection accuracy and inspection time. Aiming at this requirement, the detection technology of weld reinforcement, weld width and weld offset based on laser vision is researched and developed. By reconstructing the point cloud on the weld surface, image correction and analysis are carried out to obtain the weld surface features, and calculate the reinforcement, weld width and weld offset. The reliability and detection accuracy of the method are verified by experiments. The detection accuracy is better than that of destructive metallographic detection method. It can meet the requirements of robot welding quality evaluation, and provide the basis for exploring the relationship between welding process and weld surface quality.

articleTitle: A novel edge computing optimization method based on multi-objective optimization theory
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The continuous growth of large-scale applications of the Internet of Things (IOT) stimulates more demand for edge computing, and more and more IoT devices require edge computing. Such a large-scale node will cause the problem of excessive load pressure on the computing center. In this paper, an edge computing optimization algorithm based on a multi-objective optimization algorithm (ECO-MO) is proposed. In this algorithm, the objective functions are considered in some constrained conditions. this algorithm achieves comprehensive optimization of computing resource utilization, storage utilization, remaining power. Experiments show that this method is effective.

articleTitle: Vision Localization Algorithm for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Using Active Landmark
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: According to the problem of target recognition and localization for UAV, a target recognition and localization algorithm based on active landmark and mono vision is proposed. Two red LED lights are used in the active landmark. The flight control computer can transmit the control commands to the landmark from wireless for switch in many landmarks, the image is preprocessed with undistortion, median filtering and morphological filtering. Finally, the target is located by the contours of the landmark. The central point of the landmark in the camera coordinate can be reconstructed with the parameters of camera calibration and the coordinates in pixel plane. Then the relative location and yaw angle between UAV and target in the world coordinate system can be got. Data is optimized with the Kalman filter. The result of the experiment shows that the error of the algorism is little. This algorism has strong stability and accuracy.

articleTitle: Study on Control Algorithm for A Dual Channel Servo System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The paper aims to design a dual channel servo control system in application to positioning platform based on high-precision tracking and pointing requirement and study the algorithm thereof. The paper focuses on introduction to the operating principle of dual channel servo drive system as well as study on dual channel control algorithm, including study of control algorithm for three loops namely current loop, speed loop and position loop for rough channel as well as study of controller parameter setting algorithm for fine channel. Finally, the paper also indicates design method for coordination control strategy for dual channel servo system. Dual channel servo drive system also can also carry out large stroke and high precision movement control, with higher control precision, response velocity and robustness, having been extensively applied to military, aerospace and industry sectors.

articleTitle: Grid Industry Based Intelligent Ground Monitoring System of UAV Inspection
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The continuous development of power system enlarges the power supply scale of power grid, so the security and stability of power grid are of crucial importance to normal power supply. Accordingly, higher requirements are also proposed for the power supply capacity of power system. At present, UAV (unmanned aerial vehicle) has been widely applied in many fields based on the continuous development of some intelligent technologies, such as wireless positioning technology, remote sensing technology, wireless data transmission technology, and image processing technology. Due to the advantages of small size, low energy consumption and easy control, UAV can be applied to the field of patrol inspection of power transmission lines. Combined with the specific requirements of transmission line inspection task, this study designs the intelligent ground monitoring system of UAV inspection. The design has good application value and broad application prospects and is of great significance for the realization of intelligent power system.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Virtual Reality Technology in Healthy Landscape Design
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the fast evolution of computer technology, virtual reality technology has been widely applied in the development of various industries in our country, and it has also played an important role in the field of landscape design. For example, it can provide complete data analysis as well as input & output technology for landscape planning and design, effectively improving the work efficiency. In this paper, the application characteristics and methods of virtual reality technology at all links of the healthy landscape field are discussed. And then, the application prospect of the technology in the healthy landscape design is prospected.

articleTitle: The state inspection of upper supporting roller of conveyor in service with structural pattern recognition and cluster norm algorithm of failure
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In thermal power generation, coal transportation is an important link in the production process, and coal transportation by corridor conveyor is a common technical method. In order to ensure the normal and continuous supply of coal, it is necessary to inspect the corridor facilities, especially the working status of conveyor rollers, and timely find and deal with abnormal situations. It is difficult to meet the requirements of modern thermal coal transportation inspection due to the heavy workload and high labor intensity. A kind of inspection robot instead of manual is proposed and developed. The robot system by CCD detection, convention scanning way, classifier design and abnormal structure pattern recognition algorithm, the displacement of conveyor roller state, center, loss of revolution, abstraction of severe abrasion and crack, forms the state vector, through clustering algorithm of norm, judgment is done for determination of the roller on the working state.

articleTitle: Research on the Augmented Reality (AR) Technology to Optimize Humanized Design of Carbon-neutral Urban Landscapes
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This research involves the path, form and design method of augmented reality technology in the humanized design of carbon-neutral landscapes, with the purpose to explore how to use augmented reality technology to optimize the humanized design of carbon-neutral landscapes. During the research, it was found that: for the landscape design, to achieve carbon-neutrality, it is necessary to reduce the trial and error cost of design through the use of augmented reality technology; and for the humanized design of carbon-neutral landscapes, the use of virtuality and reality combination feature of computer augmented reality can better deliberate the simulation design, so as to achieve a real design humanization, and provide a new design idea for the realization of the carbon-neutral landscape design with technology and art collaborative innovation.

articleTitle: Strong stability for LTI system with multi-delays
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Strong delay-independent stability of MD-LTI(Linear Time Invariant with Multi-Delays) system <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\dot{x}(t)=A_{1} x(t)+\sum\limits_{i=2}^{N} A_{i} x(t-\tau_{i})$</tex>, has attracted much attention, and some encouraging results have been obtained when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{N}<=2$</tex>. However, it is complicated even infeasible to use the LMI (linear matrix inequality) to analysis(analyze) the stability of MD-LTI when <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{N}> 2$</tex>. In the paper, a quadric form based on Lyapunov matrix algebraic equation (or inequality) method for the necessary and sufficient condition of MD-LTI under the case of N>2 is proposed. Three criteria are obtained, and three numerical examples are given to illustrate the proposed method results.

articleTitle: A Class of Generalized Jacobi Matrix Eigenvalue Inverse Problems with Added Edges
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The focus of this paper is on a class of generalised Jacobi matrix eigenvalue inversion problems with added edges. These problems arise in the fields of mathematical physics, automatic control and structural design, as well as their study is of great theoretical and applied importance. The matrices are inverted with a given two eigen-pairs, and after discussing different cases, a uniqueness theorem for settlement to the question is presented, as well as numerical expressions are given, and validated by examples of numeric values.

articleTitle: The Teaching Methods in the Integration of AI with University Computers in the Context of New Engineering Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: To meet the demands of the “new engineering” construction, the problems of the existing computer science course should be paid attention, such as out of dated teaching methods and content, lack of new technologies applied in the experiments, etc. This paper analyzes the challenges of introducing AI(AI) into university computer courses, from teaching objectives, teaching content and teaching mode to give an empirical evidence. The whole process of teaching is introduced in various aspects. Assessment methods and the final evaluation is explained through questionnaires, which provides a useful reference for the further reform of university computer courses and the training of new engineering talents.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of associating polymer ASP flooding performance on enhancing oil recovery
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Hydrophobically associating polymer is a new type of polymer with salt resistance, shear resistance and high temperature resistance. The performance of associating polymer ASP flooding system was evaluated by the combination of indoor core experiment and electronic instrument test. The results showed that under the same conditions, the viscosity of the associated polymer ternary system was 3.5 times higher than that of hpam2500 polymer ternary system, and the amount of polymer dry powder decreased by 30% under the same viscosity;The resistance coefficient and residual resistance coefficient of associating polymer ternary system are higher than those of hpam2500 polymer ternary system;When the associated ternary system achieves the same viscosity and better oil displacement effect, the amount of polymer required is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$40\sim 60{\%}$</tex> less than that of hpam2500 polymer ternary system. The micro visual oil displacement device is used to simulate the process of enhancing crude oil recovery of associated ternary composite system and ordinary ternary composite system. The process of crude oil recovery is described through the dynamic image of crude oil migration, and the oil displacement effect is evaluated.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Simulation of Indirect Reciprocal Game Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Cooperative reciprocity has attached much attention in the field of research on cooperative game, and indirect reciprocity mechanism is recognized as the core mechanism to promote cooperative behaviour. In this paper, the indirect reciprocity mechanism is modeled and simulated by multi-agent simulation technology, and the influence of different reputation evaluation mechanisms on indirect reciprocity mechanism is compared and analyzed. It provides a new perspective for the modelling research of indirect reciprocity mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Digitalization on Technological Innovation and Its Spatial Spillover Effect
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to explore the impact of digitalization on technological innovation, this paper takes the provincial panel data of China from 2012 to 2019 as samples, and empirically analyses the impact mechanism of digital economy on technological innovation using two-way fixed effect model and spatial Dobbin model. The results show that digitalization not only directly promotes technological innovation in this region, but also has a negative spatial spillover effect on adjacent regions. Based on the above research conclusions, this paper believes that economic development should start with data information and technological progress to achieve digital transformation, and strive to break the obstacles of digital transformation between regions to achieve the common development of the digital economy of the whole society.

articleTitle: Design of Blockchain Application Framework for Claims Platform of Flight Delay Insurance
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Flight delay insurance is a kind of insurance to settle claims for passengers due to flight delay or cancellation caused by natural disasters, bad weather, mechanical failure and other reasons. Because flight delay insurance has the characteristics of cumbersome operation process of traditional insurance products, complex product design, manual claim audit and risk management, how to provide undeniable and traceable evidence for the attributes involved in the claim settlement of aviation delay insurance events, and how to improve the execution efficiency of insurance contracts and improve passengers' claim experience are technical problems that need to be optimized urgently. Based on the establishment of the claim platform of flight delay insurance, the introduction of blockchain technology into insurance claim can effectively give play to the technical advantages of blockchain and improve the efficiency and benefits of claim platform.

articleTitle: Research on the differences of Chinese rural family cultural consumption based on panel regression model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Due to the transfer of a large number of rural labor force to cities and the formation of rural migrant families, based on the mobility of rural families, this paper divides rural families into rural migrant families and non- migrant families. By referring to Becker's family production function, the influence of leisure time on wage rate is considered, and VNM utility function is adopted to explore the influence of leisure time on cultural consumption. On the basis of theoretical analysis, this paper constructs a panel regression model to empirically analyze the differences of cultural consumption in different rural families with different properties, The empirical results show that rural migrant families have higher cultural consumption demand than rural non- migrant families. Therefore, we should improve the income distribution system and increase the income of rural residents through multiple channels; further promote the high-quality development of new-type urbanization and accelerate the realization of the goal of common prosperity of rural farmers; Improve the average level of education and create a good cultural and entertainment consumption environment.

articleTitle: Study on load shedding of active distribution network considering the failure of the cyber system
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of line switch mal-operation in active distribution networks, a load shedding optimization model based on linear Distflow was proposed. First, the concept of line switch mal-operation was defined when the cyber system failed. Then, the switching state constraint was introduced, and the Distflow optimization model taking the minimum load shedding of the active distribution network as the objective function was established. Finally, the model was solved based on the idea of linear programming, the model feasibility is verified by the test system, and the influence of dispatch center control commands, switch malfunctions, and distributed generators on distribution network load shedding are discussed.

articleTitle: Design and control strategy of Cascaded H-bridge rectifier for energy router
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at low unity power factor and unbalanced DC voltage of Cascaded H-bridge Rectifier (CHBR) for energy router, a CHBR control strategy based on transient current control and fuzzy PI control is proposed. In this strategy, dual closed-loop controller is used as the main controller to realize sinusoidal current and high power factor, fuzzy adaptive PI control is adopted to realize capacitor voltages balance. Finally, the whole system was modelled and simulated in MATLAB, the experimental results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Laser-TIG Weld Profile Based on Neural Network and Intelligent Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This paper presents a laser welding procedure using the laser- TiG laser to weld Q235 stainless steel with a thickness of 1 mm, 2 mm, 4 mm, and 6 mm using the laser-TIG laser. To optimize laser- Tigwelding process parameters, the paper combines BP neural networks and database technology. By utilizing the three topographical size parameters of penetration depth, penetration width, and residual height, this paper converts the input and output parameters of the model and obtains a network model for predicting welding process parameters. Laser welding is more precise and higher quality. After 5000 trainings of the BP network, the system's output accuracy exceeds 0.015mm. Currently, the maximum errors of the welding fusion width ratio, the weld width, and the network output value are 0.03mm and 0.07mm, respectively. By using this system, much experimentation can be avoided. Additionally, it can significantly shorten the research cycle of hybrid welding. The optimization algorithm is of great importance in order to optimize welding process parameters.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Allocation Strategy Based on Fault-Tolerant Control Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: According to the actual situation of sports events, the physical strength distribution model and fault tolerant control model are established. According to the principle of multi-objective optimization, the improved distributed genetic algorithm was used for preliminary solving, and the corresponding fault-tolerant control law was developed to correct the strategies with errors, so as to maintain a high fault-tolerant degree while ensuring the overall score of the event as best as possible. Distributed genetic algorithm has the characteristics of strong search ability and fast search speed, and the fault-tolerant control theory can fully combine with the practice to ensure the overall fault tolerance of the strategy. Finally, the reliability and effectiveness of the algorithm are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: The Inverse Eigenvalue Problem for a Class of (1+2) X-like Matrix
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The inverse eigenvalue problem of matrix is usually a method to invert the matrix through given eigen-pairs, and the inversion method varies according to the matrix models given. This paper studies the inverse eigenvalue problem for a class of (1 +2) X-like matrix, then the existence and uniqueness of the problem solution is proved and the algorithm of uniqueness is obtained, finally the effectiveness of the algorithm is tested by numerical examples.

articleTitle: The application of Machine Learning and IOT in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Under the background of continuous optimization and adjustment of economic structure, China must strengthen the optimization of agricultural industrial structure to meet the development needs of The Times. Therefore, it is necessary to combine information technology with agricultural system effectively, establish intelligent agricultural system, integrate and analyze all kinds of information generated in agricultural operation, and promote agricultural intelligence. Agricultural machinery driven by machine learning and the Internet of Things technology is a key part of the next agricultural revolution. In this paper, the application status of machine learning in various fields of agriculture is introduced, and the application prospect of machine learning in agricultural production is prospected ° This paper also shows how knowledge agriculture improves the sustainable productivity and quality of products to enable plant yield prediction, weed and species testing.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation Method of Multi-Bays Graph In Power System based on Real-time Topological Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Substation supervisory control is an essential part of power grid monitoring system. Besides the power flow between substations, the running states of the devices in substations are important to the staff in power grid. At present, the substation devices with their running states are drawn in electrical bay graphs, which are widely used in the power grid dispatching department. Traditional electrical bay graphs contain devices in only one substation and the drawing process of the graph relies on manual work. In this paper, an automatic generation method of multi-bay graph in power system based on real-time topological model is proposed. There are two stages in the method. In the first stage, necessary model information is obtained according to topology in real-time database. In the second stage, the bay features are firstly built in the method and the classification of the bays is achieved by these features. Secondly, a data structure of device tree is proposed and the automatic layout of devices is realized based on the data structure. Finally, automatic wiring of the devices is achieved from the perspective of aesthetic and objectivity. Experimental results show that the graph drawn by the proposed method could not only reflect the actual connection mode and running states of the substation devices but also show the power flow between these substations. The proposed drawing method could reduce manual operations and improve the work efficiency of the power grid staff.

articleTitle: Application Research for real time computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In the era of big data and artificial intelligence, the key performance indicators of real-time computing encounter many challenges. It is very difficult to realize real-time computing by using traditional computing tools. This research will introduce the specific application research of Flink in real-time computing through the production and practice process of Apache Flink in real-time computing. Through the research, it is found that Flink has good performance in massive data, real-time ETL, real-time risk control, distributed call chain analysis and other application cases. Research and propose specific Flink platform construction technology methods, and put forward improvement measures for several Flink problems encountered in the process of Flink platform.

articleTitle: ScaleChem Scaling Prediction Software Used in oil well scaling and protection in Heyangshan oil area
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to solve the scaling problem of oil well in Heyangshan oil area, the composition of produced water of oil well was detected, and the OLI ScaleChem Software was used to predict the fouling species and scaling amount; the scaling sample was analysed by X-ray diffraction analysis. The causes of scale and corrosion of oil wells were discussed, and the effect of corrosion and scale inhibitor was evaluated. The results showed that the scaling type of oil well in Heyangshan oil area was calcium carbonate, which consistent with what the software predicted. The maximum scale amount predicted by the OLI ScaleChem Software was greater than 176.2 mg L-1.The scale corrosion inhibitor of the SW-632 can effectively solve the problem of corrosion and scaling of oil well in this area.

articleTitle: Identification of Point Spread Function based on Turbulent Blur Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: To solve the complexity of blur in Aero-optics, we proposed a method of identification based on the turbulent blur model, namely an improved least-square point spread function identification method. Combined with the characteristics of the flow field, select the initial value in this method. Solve the second-order difference of the point spread function identified in the process of each two iterations, and observe its changes before and after. When the second-order difference tends to be stable, the iteration ends, and the iteration times at this time can be used as the iteration times of the least-square. The improved method can obtain the accurate result by improving the initial value and iteration times of conjugate gradient method. The proposed method is studied, and the experimental results illustrate the method's efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-Defect Model Recognition Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: As an important part of the safe operation of the power grid, the air switchgear will cause inevitable economic losses when it fails. Aiming at the problems of low fault recognition rate and lack of credibility of test results in air switchgear, this paper proposes to combine machine learning to identify common fault defect types in switchgear, analyse PRPD maps of each defect model and statistical feature values as machine learning inputs. PNN probabilistic neural network, POS-SVM algorithm and SOM self-organizing neural network training were used to determine the optimal algorithm. Research shows that the PSO-SVM model is chosen as the most suitable model for the discharge mode judgment of the switchgear.

articleTitle: A constrained multi-objective evolutionary algorithm based on weak cooperation framework and multi-chaotic operators
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm (LCMO) based on weak co evolution framework and multi chaotic operators. In the framework of two population weak cooperation, we use hybrid chaotic operators to help candidate solution populations improve their distribution uniformity, and use the second selection criteria to refine Pareto level. In this paper, The IGD and true Pareto Front performance indicators obtained from the experiments verify the good performance of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of NQI One-stop Service Effectiveness Evaluation Index System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: National quality infrastructure one-stop service is a whole chain, all-round and whole-process service for enterprises, industries, regions, especially small and medium-sized enterprises, through the organic integration of measurement, standards, certification and accreditation, inspection and testing, quality management and other elements of resources. This paper aims to study the index system and method for national quantitative evaluation of quality infrastructure one-stop service effectiveness. The evaluation index system of NQI one-stop service effectiveness composed of 3 target layers, 14 element layers and 23 index layers was constructed and formed, and the evaluation method was analysed in order to provide theoretical basis and evaluation basis for continuously improving the effectiveness of NQI one-stop service.

articleTitle: Recognition Method of Two Types of Insulation Joints Based on Wavelet Transform and SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Mechanical insulation joints in track circuits are generally insulated by gluing, and their smoothness is generally weaker than that of electrical insulation joints, which will cause high-frequency vibration of vehicles in case of serious damage. In this paper, we propose a method to identify the two types of mechanical and electrical insulation joints effectively based on wavelet transform and support vector machine (SVM) according to the characteristic attributes of data signals. Firstly, the location of the insulation joint is realized based on the modulus maxima of the wavelet transform and the characteristics of the signal at the insulation joint. Secondly, the samples are divided according to the position point and the length of the insulation joint, and the features of the samples are extracted. Finally, the SVM algorithm is utilized to construct a classification model for distinguishing the two types of insulation joints. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can effectively locate and distinguish the two types of insulation joints.

articleTitle: Research on Pattern Recognition Performance of Control Chart Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This paper is aiming at the problem that the existing anomaly discrimination methods of control chart can not realize the discrimination of complex anomaly data and the low level of intelligence. It is exploring the performance of control chart pattern recognition based on deep learning. It briefly introduces 1DCNN, LSTM and BiLSTM then adopts a neural network model based on 1DCNN+BiLSTM. The Monte Carlo method is used to generate the simulation data of the control chart, and different abnormal data are generated by changing the parameters for simulation experiments. According to the effect of control chart pattern recognition under different abnormal data, the training samples are optimized and the parameters of the network model are determined. The results show that the proposed method performs better in recognition.

articleTitle: Simulation of fringe order of photoelastic samples based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to solve the problem of traditional photoelastic fringe recognition and automatic grading through the BP artificial neural network. The nonlinear mapping relationship between the RGB value of each point on the photoelastic picture and the fringe order of the corresponding point is verified to resolve the problem. The simulation analysis is carried out by the BP neural network. The simulation analysis data shows that it has a favorable effect on fringes below grade 4.

articleTitle: Research of Pedestrian Object Tracking Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: High-quality pedestrian tracking algorithms are the basis for solving many problems including video surveillance, action recognition, and crowd behaviour analysis. The problem of pedestrian target detection and tracking is to identify and track the trajectories of different targets in video sequences. It can be divided into single target and tracking, multi-target and tracking, pedestrian re-identification, and so on. In recent years, with improvement of benchmarking, pedestrian object tracking methods have also developed from traditional feature learning to neural network modelling. This paper mainly summarizes and analyses the latest proposed deep learning algorithm models for pedestrian detection and tracking and the corresponding improvement for existing problems. In addition, possible future research directions are also discussed at the end.

articleTitle: Analysis of Image Transmission Traffic Based on Queuing Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology and digital technology, the industrial control field urgently needs intelligent and digital transformation. Making full use of the industrial camera can get twice the result with half the effort in the process of industrial production and remote maintenance. In this paper, the industrial camera first collects the information of radium carving crafts on the production site, and then processes the collected data into giant frames and transmits them to the host PC for processing through the GigE Vision Protocol. At the same time, the industrial camera traffic is modeled. According to the camera traffic model, the data packets of each camera are queued during the data transmission process. Under the premise of a certain tolerable packet loss rate and delay, the combination of optimal bandwidth utilization and buffer size is calculated. Then the industrial camera resolution and packet size at the lowest cost are obtained.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation Analysis of Jet Flow Field Characteristics of PDC Bits with Three Holes
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Based on the traditional PDC drill bits, optimized and improved, there is no center nozzle, and the aperture of three oblique nozzles with an inclination of 20 0 is increased. Using the numerical simulation analysis method, and using the SST k-ω model, the characteristics of the jet flow field of the PDC bits are studied, and the jet flow velocity and pressure gradient of the bottom hole, nozzle and blade surface are numerically analyzed. The results show that the optimized PDC bits can efficiently break the rock through the three inclined holes close to the center of the bit. At the same time, it improves the uneven distribution of hydraulic energy of the traditional PDC bits. It can better increase the bottom hole velocity and increase the high-speed overflow, reduce the accumulation of bottom hole debris, raise the fluid up-and-back area, enhance the fluid's rock-carrying capacity, reduce the possibility of vortices and mud packs, and have a significant bit cleaning effect.

articleTitle: Evaluation Design and Improvement on Higher Vocational College Teaching Evaluation System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, a large number of higher vocational college teaching data norm extraction with the appropriate model design and improvement. So as to improve the effectiveness of data analysis, it provides powerful classroom analysis support for classroom teaching evaluation in higher vocational education. The concept of overall distribution is used to describe the overall data state by presenting the distribution diagram. The big data simulation analysis results can provide reference or basis for the construction of normal model resources of classroom teaching quality of teachers in vocational colleges as a whole.

articleTitle: Trust Recommended Algorithm Based on DDPG and Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
