abstract: In view of the insufficient researches on the dynamic change of user trust in existing trust-based recommendation algorithms, a DDPG-TRA algorithm based on deep reinforcement learning and attention mechanism is proposed, which can catch the user interests and dynamically update user trust. The algorithm firstly uses the state module combined with the attention mechanism to model the user's state, and then recommends item. When the user adopts the item, it integrates social trust relationships and similarity relationships to predict item score, and computes the error between the predicted score and the actual score. Finally, the algorithm gets the recommendation reward and updates the trust with the score difference. We conduct experiments on three datasets and compared with other algorithms, and the proposed algorithm can get more accurate results.

articleTitle: Building and Application of Calculation Model for Determination of Cut Tobacco Content of Individual Cigarettes
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to effectively control the cigarette making process and improve the overall quality of cigarettes, the calculation model for determination of the cut tobacco content of individual cigarettes was established by performing data statistics and analysis on the main factors affecting the cut tobacco content of cigarette samples with different specifications, and the making process was controlled to test the weight and suction resistance of cigarettes before and after the control. The results show that 1. The correlation coefficient R of the calculation model built is 0.987, R2 is 0.973, and the correlation between the cut tobacco content of individual cigarettes and each affecting factor is good; 2. After the cut tobacco content of individual cigarettes is converted into the value corresponding to the target weight control, the standard errors of weight and suction resistance as well as the average value of weight and suction resistance have been greatly reduced. Main Conclusion: 1. The calculation model for determination of the cut tobacco content of individual cigarettes has a high accuracy, and it is suitable to be popularized; 2. When the cut tobacco content of individual cigarettes is converted into the value corresponding to the target weight control, the relative physical indicators such as the weight and suction resistance of the cigarettes fluctuate less, and their performance is more stable, which is conducive to the improvement of the overall quality of cigarettes.

Author Keywords: Cut Tobacco Content of Individual Cigarettes

articleTitle: A Smart Cuckoo Filter with Disjoint-set to Detect the Endless Loop
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Cuckoo filter is a new type of approximate membership query data structure that stores the fingerprints of set elements. Because of its higher performance than bloom filter, cuckoo filter has been developed in recent years and gradually replaced the bloom filter in many fields. However, the endless loop problem in cuckoo hashing makes element insertion inefficient and unstable, which hinders cuckoo filter development. To solve this problem, we propose a new variant of cuckoo filter called smart cuckoo filter. Smart cuckoo filter uses a variable bucket structure to save the element insertion information at each position. It keeps buckets aligned to memory, thereby reducing the space waste and inefficiency of data access. Smart cuckoo filter uses the disjoint-set to determine whether the element will fall into the endless loop before the element is inserted. Also, the insertion is friendly to the concurrency of the entire filter. The experiments demonstrate that the element insertion speed of smart cuckoo filter in the endless loops is better than that of the traditional cuckoo filter, which can reach 2.2x in some cases.

articleTitle: Screenless Aerial 3D Display
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: It was our long time dream to draw three-dimensional images in the space nothing but air without any screen and any wearable devices such as VR goggles. Formerly, we have demonstrated aerial three-dimensional images without any screen by plasma forming using a pulse laser. We can see them in the air without any wearable devices. In order to draw higher-definition animations, we are developing contents and equipment. We would like to show the way how to draw visible images in the air and introduce two types of demonstrators. The one is “ Aerial 3D Display ” as a proof machine, and the other is “Super Real Vison (SRV)” as a small general-purpose machine. Then, we discuss future research and development of contents.

articleTitle: Analysis and suggestion of double-blind review comments based on NLP technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The double-blind review dissertation is a key link in strengthening quality supervision and inspection, promoting standardized management of degree awarding, improving internal quality assurance system, and accelerating the high-quality development of postgraduate education in the new era. Experts review the dissertation and put forward revision opinions, which largely reflect the problems existing in the dissertation, and have important reference value for the guidance of graduate dissertation. This paper analyzes the review comments received by computer dissertations through word cloud analysis, text feature extraction and other NLP technologies, summarizing common problems and puts forward corresponding suggestions, so as to provide more targeted reference for the guidance of dissertations.

articleTitle: Level set method by using local entropy and enhanced LoG operator for image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Level set evolution is an essential method for image segmentation. However, the region-based level set is sensitive to contour initialization, and it is difficult to obtain good results in images with intensity inhomogeneity. We propose an improved level set method based on local entropy and enhanced Laplacian of Gaussian (LoG) operator for image segmentation. Specifically, the local entropy reflects the local intensity variations, which improves the method's ability to handle inhomogeneity. Then, the enhanced LoG operator smoothes the heterogeneous regions to reduce the influence of the regions on the curve. Experimental results show that the method can effectively segment inhomogeneous images and has good adaptability to contour initialization and noise.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of an extensible intelligent problem generation system for college students' programming courses
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In college students' programming, there is a general imbalance between theoretical and practical teaching. The online problem judge system is an excellent way to improve students' programming practice ability, which can judge the student's online submitted program by preset test cases of the problem. However, the online problem judge system requires teachers to write many online problems for the programming courses they teach. Teachers are under great pressure to produce problems, resulting in a lower-than-expected course effect. Therefore, this paper puts forward the idea of constructing the intelligent problem generation software for college students' programming courses and realizes the intelligent problem generation system for college students' programming courses based on the concept of automatic problem generation machine. The system is based on the idea of extensibility and modularization, so that different modules can be continuously loaded into the application program in the form of dynamic link libraries, and it can also generate online test cases while randomly generating problems, thereby reducing the burden of problem generation for programming teachers.

articleTitle: Applied Research on Construction of Real-Time Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to construct a real-time computing platform for processing stream data and batch data simultaneously; Using experimental verification and comprehensive analysis methods; Experiments were conducted to compare Flink with spark structured streaming, deploy it on Yan, combine Flink with spring, and Flink asynchronously does not support the use of keyedstate and Flink CEP; Get the result that Flink can organically integrate stream processing and batch processing; It is concluded that Flink meets the requirements of low latency, exactly once guarantee, high throughput and efficient processing.

articleTitle: Vision Localization and Compensation Technology for Clamping Error in Faucet Robotic Grinding
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the difficulty of the initial localization error in the automatic grinding process of the faucet robot, In this paper, a localization and compensation method based on machine vision is proposed to solve the problem of difficulty in clamping and localization of faucet blanks, and realize automatic grasping localization and grinding compensation of robots. Experimental results show that the proposed vision localization compensation system can accurately detect localization errors and effectively compensate them, which verifies the advanced and effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A novel teaching model based on Web Mining and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of current distance teaching sites with few interactive means and inability to teach students in accordance with their aptitude, a remote teaching model based on Web mining and data mining is proposed. And the realization algorithm is given. This model makes full use of the various information accumulated on the site to help course designers and managers to redesign courses and reconstruct sites. so that the design of courses is more reasonable and in line with teaching regulations. Learners can also give full play to their own personality. The model, compared with the WWW-based one, is more beneficial to distance education, and has broad development and application prospects.

articleTitle: Image style transfer based on decoupled representation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The present methods of image style transfer lack the ability to express the image content, which leads to the poor quality and lack of diversity of stylized images. This paper proposes a style transfer method based on image decoupled representation. Generator network is composed of content encoder and style encoder for feature extraction. Decoder generates target image; The discriminator enhances the rationality of the target image. Define two mapping functions to map content features in domain-crossed shared content space to domain independent content spaces. Using Photo2Monet, Cat2Dog, and photographic 2portrait data sets, we found that the domain independent content spaces better represents the content, and style transfer effect is better. The average FID index value was 56.59. The average value of LPIPS index was 0.3749.

articleTitle: Existence and uniqueness of solutions for a class of matrix eigenvalue inverse problems with proportional relations
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, the inverse eigenvalue problem[1] of a class of special matrix with proportional relationship is studied. Through two given characteristic pairs, the characteristics of the existence and uniqueness of the matrix are discussed. The expression and algorithm for solving the problem are given. This possibility is verified by an example

articleTitle: Intelligent Insole Design and Gait Analysis Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the development of sensing technology, the continuous progress of Artificial Intelligence and Internet-of-Things technology, intelligent medical terminals are becoming more and more popular. Today, with the improving miniaturization and flexibility of sensors, their characteristics are more and more consistent with intelligent medical technology. As a result, the research and applications of wearable medical devices are rapidly emerging. Currently, most of the existing gait analysis systems give judgments based on the displacement of some specific parts of human body, rather than plantar pressure. Based on wireless plantar sensing network, deep neural network, and cloud platform technology, this work proposes and demonstrates a smart shoe insole implanted with flexible feet pressure sensors and a data processing system. The meshless integrated sensing scheme is used to detect the regional distribution of plantar pressure, in order to collect and analyze the gait data of users. The intelligent medical terminal transmits the collected data to the cloud server and uses neural network to accurately analyze the gait of users. Medical personnel and remote observers can give medical advice or care to users based on the analysis. The sensing unit and circuit board of the flexible pressure sensors are all made of flexible materials. The replaceable battery can continuously work for 48 hours and the effective communication range is 65 meters indoor under barrier-free conditions. This intelligent insole design has a promising future and is applicable for a wider range of scenarios, including health monitoring and medical treatment.

articleTitle: Abnormal Behavior Analysis Based on Truth Discovery and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Abnormal behavior analysis has been extensively studied in social network security. Many abnormal users often post advertising links, spread false news, and even launch malicious attacks. Existing solutions of abnormal behaviors analysis mainly focus on low-dimensional features. In this paper, we propose an advanced analysis scheme for abnormal behaviors, providing the following properties: behavioral, semantic and temporal based feature extraction, multi-dimensional feature learning based on LightGBM, BiLSTM and SVM, and abnormal behavior analysis based on truth discovery. The performance evaluation shows that the proposed scheme can achieve 96.7% accuracy and is efficient and feasible.

articleTitle: Research on Chinese Word Segmentation Algorithm based on Dictionary and Statistical Method and Its Application in the field of Power Grid Control
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In view of the particularity of Chinese word segmentation in the professional field of power grid regulation, the performance of Chinese word segmentation based on traditional statistical algorithm is frequently limited by the corpus training in the proprietary field, and the insufficient ability of Chinese word segmentation based on dictionary algorithm in identifying new words and disambiguation in the proprietary field. This paper proposes a Chinese word segmentation method based on the combination of dictionary and statistical method, and applies it to the application scenario of querying the operation status of power grid. This method constructs a professional dictionary in the field of power grid regulation by using the Double-Array Tree storage structure. Then using the CRF(Conditional Random Fields) train the text data to generate the model file, and the FMM(Forward Maximum Matching) method is used for Chinese word segmentation combined with the professional dictionary in the field of power grid regulation. A fast and accurate online word segmentation method in the field of power grid regulation is designed and implemented, it performs well in some main performance indexes. In the application scenario of querying the power grid operation status, the Chinese word segmentation results obtained by this method combined with the standard query sentence pattern realize the rapid classification of application scenario query and the accurate execution of operation commands, greatly improve the efficiency and accuracy of querying the power grid operation status, and improve the human-computer interaction experience.

Author Keywords: Scenario application of power grid regulation

articleTitle: Research Trend in the International Literatures on Machine Translation Based on CiteSpace
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the continuous development of computer, machine translation has experienced from “mechanical brain” to neural network machine translation based on deep learning. It is constantly innovating in technology and upgrading in algorithm. With the attempt to clarify the development characteristics, development status, advantages and limitations of the machine translation system at each stage, this study collects the machine translation research data from the databases of SCI and SSCI since the 1990s and analyzes them with the assist of CiteSpace so as to looking forward to the future of machine translation.

articleTitle: Construction and Analysis of Higher Vocational College Teaching Evaluation System Resources Based on Data Mining Function
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to make an objective evaluation on the teaching quality of the teachers in the course, and promote the teaching reform and the improvement of the teaching quality, a Municipal Public Vocational College in Beijing organizes students'evaluation, supervision and peer evaluation of teaching at the end of each semester. The data entry contains information such as teacher number, faculty, Peer Review, supervised evaluation, student evaluation, and weighted total score, all of which are in the 100-point scale. In order to analyze the difference of teachers'evaluation scores among peers, supervisors and students, the three attribute scores were sorted out and analyzed. Based on the analysis, peer and supervisory assessment scores are more professional than student assessment scores, and can reflect teachers' real teaching performance.

articleTitle: Traffic sign recognition based on YOLOX in extreme weather
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the rise of machine learning and deep learning, the accuracy and speed of traffic sign recognition in the direction of computer vision have been continuously improved in recent years, but most of the literature and research are based on clear unobstructed This paper studies the problem of traffic sign recognition that becomes blurred in rainy and snowy weather, fog and haze weather, and the speed of the vehicle is too fast. The newly proposed YOLOX model is used to train and test the data set. The final experimental results show that the accuracy of using the YOLOX model to identify pictures after deblurring is improved, which is better than other models, but the types of pictures are not rich enough. The similarity with the real traffic scene needs to be improved.

articleTitle: Research on a mechanical model of subsea Christmas tree during Lowering Stage in Deepwater based on Sea Trial
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: To explore the mechanical characteristics of the Christmas tree lowering system and the sensitivity of influencing factors under typical deepwater lowering conditions., based on the self-improved mechanical model of the subsea Christmas tree lowering system., the parameter sensitivity analysis of the subsea Christmas tree lowering process in the deepwater lowering stage is carried out., to establish the mechanical characteristics of Christmas tree dropping system under this condition. The analysis results show that the deepwater lowering stage is mainly affected by the combined action of wave force and current force. With the increase of surface current velocity and wave height., the lateral displacement., stress., and bending moment increase. The increase caused by surface current velocity is the largest., followed by the influence of wave height., and the change caused by period and wind speed is not obvious. Deepwater lowering causes too much lateral displacement of the Christmas tree. The main reason for the docking failure is the current force., and the maximum lateral displacement is determined to be 2.7 m by converting the current velocity into the lateral displacement.

articleTitle: The role of image analysis technique in fire cause investigation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The essence of video investigation is a process of information processing. Through the information extraction and analysis of video surveillance video, we can obtain the clues related to the case and determine the internal connection between people and things on the scene and between things in time and space. It is a general term for a series of business processes such as the collection and analysis of case videos by the public security organs, and a specific implementation of artificial intelligence and big data in the public security industry. Digital image processing technology includes image acquisition and digitization, image compression, image enhancement and restoration, image segmentation and image analysis and so on. It plays an important role in modern fire investigation technology. According to the requirements of fire scene inspection, image analysis is carried out on the surveillance camera data in a certain area to find out the abnormal light position, providing basic data for the determination of fire location or fire point, and providing the most powerful evidence for the investigation of fire cause. In the case of no trace of material evidence in the fire scene, the accuracy of fire cause investigation is greatly improved and the scientific basis for fire investigation is provided.

articleTitle: High precision description of Superconvergence points for spectral interpolation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In [10], superconvergence properties for some high-order orthogonal poly- nomial interpolations are investigated. It presents derivative superconvergence points approximation which doesn't reach machine precision, especially near the endpoints. In this work, Our results provide derivatives superconvergent points of 14 digits of accuracy. In combination with approximated initial value, we compute first derivative superconvergent points by Newton iteration method arriving at machine precision. Numerical experiment demonstrate higher precision at endpoints.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Short-Time Interruption Traffic Conditions for Bridge Widening Project
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: For the uninterrupted bridge widening project, the joint part will have an adverse effect on the modified bridge due to the difference in traffic conditions on both sides of the old and new bridge, which will lead to inconsistent forces on both sides. A rapid-hardening and early-strength concrete was used as a joint material, taking a simple-supported I-girder bridge in an actual project as a study case. The dynamic response analysis of the bridge under vehicle load at 4.5 h after joint casting was analyzed. The maximum tensile stress at the splice joint of the old and new bridge under different vehicle conditions, the maximum deflection difference between the two sides of the span of the splice joint and the vibration speed of the splice joint were obtained respectively. The feasibility of only closing the lane for 4.5 h after the joint casting also been verified.

articleTitle: MDNet: Multi-scale densely connected segmentation architecture with channel attention for automatic hippocampal segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Morphological analysis of the hippocampus based on magnetic resonance imaging is of great significance for the computer-aided diagnosis of neuropsychiatric diseases. In this study, we propose a multi-scale densely connected segmentation architecture for automatic hippocampal segmentation. First, consider that single-scale feature extraction cannot accurately segment the hippocampus from the background. We design a multi-scale densely connected module to extract contextual information at different scales and levels and learn the spatial dependencies and details of the hippocampus through different scales. Then, channel attention is used to model the correlation between features at different scales, effectively highlighting the features of the hippocampus and suppressing irrelevant background information. Finally, multi-scale feature fusion is performed to achieve accurate segmentation of the hippocampus. Validation results on the ADNI hippocampus dataset show that the model has a DICE coefficient score of 0.9283, outperforming other classical segmentation methods.

articleTitle: Research on accurate direction finding method of vortex electromagnetic wave radio proximity sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Iming at the demand of the new generation of air defense missile directional warhead for accurate detection of short-range targets, this paper studies the accurate direction finding method of vortex electromagnetic wave radio proximity sensor. Based on the working principle of pulse Doppler system, the mathematical model of vortex electromagnetic wave radio proximity sensor is established; On this basis, the vortex echo signal is approximately deformed to construct the guidance vector matrix and the received signal model. The rotation invariant propagation operator algorithm is used to estimate the target azimuth, and the performance of the algorithm is verified by Monte Carlo simulation experiment. The results show that this method can achieve accurate direction finding under the condition of low signal-to-noise ratio and few array elements.

articleTitle: Generative adversarial networks combined with deep feature interpolation for image style transfer
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Image style transfer technique is a popular topic in computer vision. This paper proposes a reconstructed generator model based on Cycle Generative Adversarial Networks (CycleGAN) for image style transfer tasks. Firstly, deep feature interpolation is performed to extract image high-level semantic representations in deep feature space, and then it is combined with CycleGAN to construct a new deep network model. In this model, the generator network is organized by sampling layers and residual modules. According to the above process, a new deep feature generator is designed to realize the cross-region style transfer. Experiments are carried out on several standard datasets, horse2zebr, monet2photo and summer2winter. The model is evaluated through the objective evaluation indicators of PSNR and SSIM. Experimental results show a better performance improvement compared to the classical CycleGAN.

articleTitle: Locating the source of voltage sags based on CNN-Disturbance power method
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Accurate location of transient fault source is helpful to reduce the economic loss caused by voltage sag. The traditional localization methods can't accurately locate source and distinguish the classification of transient sources. Therefore, this paper proposes the disturbance power method based on CNN (Convolutional Neural Network, CNN) for locating voltage sag sources. This method can be divided into three steps: 1) generates feature vector sets by extracting various types of transient signal feature vectors; 2) trains convolutional neural networks with the feature data sets; 3) combines the perturbed power method to achieve the cause identification and localization of voltage sag. This method can accurately identify and classify the causes of voltage sag and locate the source of voltage sag. Performance and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified through the simulation and field case.

articleTitle: Effect of Nonlinear Creep on Long-Term Deflection of Externally Prestressed Concrete Beams
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to study the influence of nonlinear creep effect on the long-term deflection of externally prestressed concrete beams, a nonlinear creep model considering the damage evolution of concrete is proposed based on the effective modulus method adjusted by age and combined with the random fracture model of concrete micro spring. Based on ABAQUS finite element software for secondary development, a nonlinear creep subroutine is written. The long-term deflection of externally prestressed concrete beams is calculated by finite element method and compared with the measured value. The results show that the calculated value of deflection is consistent with the measured value. In the early stage of loading, the calculated value is about 15% larger than the measured value. After 400 days of loading, the difference between the calculated value and the measured value of midspan deflection is within 5%. The difference between the calculated and measured values of L/4 and 3L/4 span deflections is within 10%. The calculated value is larger than the measured value, which has a certain safety reserve to calculate the long-term deflection of externally prestressed concrete beams by this method.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis on Nonlinear Creep Effect of Reinforced Concrete Beams
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to numerically analyze the influence of nonlinear creep effect on the long-term deflection of reinforced concrete beams under different stress levels, this paper considers the strength attenuation caused by concrete damage in the Miguel nonlinear creep model, and introduces the evolution parameters of concrete compressive damage by using the strain equivalent hypothesis. Combined with the Chinese design specification, the value of damage evolution parameter is determined, and a new nonlinear creep model is established. ANSYS UPFs was used for secondary development, and the nonlinear creep model subroutine and the linear creep model subroutine of Chinese design specification were compiled. The mid-span deflection variation of reinforced concrete beams under long-term load was obtained by finite element calculation. The results show that when the compressive stress of concrete is less than 0.4 times of the axial compressive strength of concrete, the calculation results of the nonlinear creep model established in this paper are consistent with those of the linear creep model in the design specification. When the compressive stress of concrete is 0.4 ~ 0.7 times of the axial compressive strength of concrete, the nonlinear creep model established in this paper has better prediction capability than the linear creep model in the design specification.

articleTitle: Study on Control Strategy of Vanadium based Catalyst Ammonia Storage Capacity based on Dspace/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Vanadium based catalyst (VBC) as a core technology of SCR Technology, its ammonia storage capacity seriously restricting the function of SCR system. In this paper based on dspace/simulink platform, the adsorption mechanism of NH3 on VBC was studied, discussing the selective reduction process of SCR. Through the ammonia storage capacity experiment of VBC for NH3, it is found that: temperature has a great influence of the storage capacity of the catalysts to ammonia, the capacity decreases with the increase of temperature, the storage capacity is hardly affected by space velocity and the concentration of sample gas. This study established the dspace/simulink data control platform, explored the vacuum of storage capacity of catalyst to ammonia, providing theoretical basis for improving the utilization efficiency of VBC and further formulating the diesel exhaust emission control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Recognition Algorithm of Hole Array Code Based on Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: It is very important to accurately identify the materials on the production line in the production application scenario of modern industrial Internet of Things. In the intelligent manufacturing assembly line of pressure vessels, it is difficult to identify the cylinders of pressure vessels in real time. In order to identify the gas cylinders on the intelligent production line accurately and quickly, the hole array code is used to identify the gas cylinders and the intelligent image processing algorithm based on OpenCV is used to locate the hole array code on the gas cylinders, and the result of the hole array code identification on the gas cylinders is converted into a binary marking data. By using the circle detection and intelligent identification algorithm in OpenCV, the identification accuracy and real-time detection efficiency of positioning holes are ensured, and the final verification accuracy reaches 99.2%.

articleTitle: Research on the method of constructing tree branch skeleton based on point cloud data
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a new method for constructing tree branch skeleton lines, using 3D laser scanning technology to measure several single tree point clouds, using them as data sources for accurate alignment, and performing initial denoising on the aligned overall tree point clouds. The point cloud data is secondly denoised, and the point cloud data with multiple tree branches in the same layer are identified by clustering, and the feature points of each segment are sorted and extracted to extract the skeleton points, and finally the tree branch skeleton line is constructed by building a minimum spanning tree.

articleTitle: Effect of polymer application on reservoir physical properties in oil and gas field production
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In the process of oil and gas field exploitation, polymer is the most widely used method to improve oil and gas recovery. In order to study the influence law of polymer on reservoir physical properties in the process of enhancing oil recovery, the reservoir physical parameters are studied according to the data of coring wells. The results show that by using the existing polymer mother liquor distribution and transportation system, the dilution mixed transportation system is designed to control the concentration of dilution mixed solution from 0 to 3000mg/L. The dilution mixing system has the functions of sewage treatment, accurate mixing and intelligent transportation. After mixing in long-distance pipelines, the polymer solution is more uniform; The beam pumping unit with four-bar linkage mechanism has low production degree of high permeability reservoir before the application of polymer. After polymer displacement, the crude oil recovery in high permeability reservoir is improved. After polymer flooding, the permeability increases obviously, and the porosity is mainly distributed in the range of 26% ~ 32%; Before the application of polymer, the mud is mainly distributed in the range of 6% ~12%, while after the application, the mud is mainly distributed in the range of 3% ~9%; The permeability and porosity increase with the decrease of shale content before and after the application of polymer. Clarifying the impact of polymer application on reservoir physical properties in oil and gas field production and reasonably planning and designing injection production system have important guiding significance for the application of polymer to the efficient development of reservoir.

articleTitle: Medical Imaging Analysis using Computer-Assisted Technologies
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Analysis of medical images using computer-assisted technologies has been on the rise in the recent past. Machine and deep learning have proven to be reliable in the biomedical field, providing solutions to the analysis of many health issues. Machine learning platforms are a great tool in obtaining and analyzing medical images especially when a considerable implementation effort is made. Following this, efforts have been put into research pertaining to the application of this technology to give reliable results as far as diagnosis and images are concerned. This paper looks at developing a model that will be used in medical imaging technology using machine learning. The main aim is to come up with a model that can be adopted and simplify medical imaging. This work provides a machine learning pipeline to be applied in medical imaging such as regression, segmentation, generation of images, and learning applications. The components of this model include data loading, augmentation of data, networks build-ups, loss functions, and evaluating matrices that take advantage of medical image analysis. This model will allow researchers and medical practitioners to adopt a fast and efficient method to be applied in medical imaging.

articleTitle: Design of graphite purification device based on DBD plasma technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the current plasma technology in the graphite purification process, this experiment adopts the dielectric barrier discharge plasma technology to carry out redox purification of graphite, and realizes the plasma oxidation of graphite molecules and the decomposition of interlayer domains under the condition of micro-streamer discharge, so as to achieve the purification of graphite. In this paper, a purification device that is easy to manufacture and operate is designed using the oxidative and reducible properties of graphite, and a new graphite purification method is also proposed, which can continuously process a large number of graphite materials. Therefore, the problems existing in the high temperature method are solved, such as complex equipment, long production cycle, high cost, and unfavorable industrial production. The whole process proposed in this paper does not produce waste liquid, and has the advantages of low cost, safety and environmental protection. The experimental results show that the graphite purification process proposed in this paper can purify the graphite with a carbon content of 79.4% to a carbon content of more than 99%.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Machine Vision Inspection System for Micro Gear
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to ensure the accuracy of the calculation and quantification results of tooth length error, a machine vision detection system with perfect functions and strong practicability is designed. Firstly, the wavelet transform method is used to completely remove the image noise, and the Radom transform algorithm is used to complete the accurate and scientific correction of the part image. Then, the cubic curve model is used to complete the comprehensive and complete extraction of sub-pixel edge information, and then; The projection mapping method is used to calculate the boundary position accurately. Finally, the dynamic range of the gear center point is calculated accurately, and according to the final calculation result, whether the tooth length error calculation is reasonable or not is accurately judged. The experimental results show that the precision and accuracy of the machine vision inspection system designed in this paper can reach 2μ m and 99% respectively. In addition, the inspection time of a single frame and a single part is relatively short, which is 18ms and 5s, respectively. In short, the system has the characteristics of high inspection efficiency and accuracy, which fully meets the relevant standards and requirements of industrial inspection.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Reverse Cross Region File Transmission Method between Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the complex process of reverse cross region data transmission and the different requirements of application cross region data transmission, a reverse cross region file transmission method between systems is designed and implemented. On the basis of the safe transmission of files by the reverse isolation device, the file sending and receiving agent module is added to encode, decode, format convert and rename the files, and ensure the order and reliability of reverse transmission through file time sequencing and window control. This method realizes the orderly, stable and reliable transmission of files across reverse regions, and has been applied to many applications of the new generation scheduling system.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Shapley Value in Benefit Distribution of Industry-University-Research Institute
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Based on constructing its mathematical model. The benefits of each participant in the alliance are determined by optimall caculation methods called Shapley value. Benefits of Scientific and rational distribution is the guarantee for the stable operation of the industry-university-research alliance, which plays a decisive role in the sustainable and stable development of the cooperative relationship. The Shapley allocation method does not take into account the importance of resources to the coalition. In This paper, the Shapley value is properly improved, and the cost value and resource value of the resources invested by the members in the alliance are fully considered. So as to realize the fair and reasonable distribution of the interests of the industry-university-research alliance.

articleTitle: NTP Security Threats and Countermeasures of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: NTP is very important in power system, but its security is weak due to its own connectionless characteristics. On the basis of expounding the basic working principle of NTP, it is pointed out that the main security threats to NTP are DOS attack and spoofing attack. The security threats of NTP are analyzed, and four attack modes and their characteristics are given. Finally, according to the security threats of NTP, the basic countermeasures are put forward.

articleTitle: BIM lightweight computer data processing and information sharing platform application
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of lightweight processing of BIM model, the role of BIM technology in collaborative management and information interaction is studied and explored. Based on the self-developed BIM collaborative construction management platform, the lightweight processing technology of the super-mass BIM model is analyzed and studied, including the optimization of the geometric structure with parametric description, the rendering processing methods such as multiple LOD, batch drawing and occlusion and culling, etc., to optimize the loading of the platform model. Combined with the practical application of the case project, the EPC management methods such as progress, quality, safety and cost based on the BIM platform are provided. The experience summarized can provide reference for the lightweight processing of large-scale BIM models and the construction project management based on BIM.

articleTitle: Development of complete set of layout system for temporary standardized modules
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Based on the shortcomings and characteristics of traditional temporary construction design software, this paper studies the in-depth design and family information addition of temporary construction standardized module family, the three-dimensional rapid layout of temporary construction standardized module family and the software platform of standardized module family.

articleTitle: Application of Improved BP Neural Network in Blog Post Heat Prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Microblog has become a public platform for individuals, organizations and business groups to express their ideas. Blog posts of microblog are the carriers of many interests. This method used Simplified Chinese Language Exploration and Word Measurement (SC-LIWC) software to extract the emotional vocabulary of a large number of blog posts, and extracted six main emotional vocabulary and three heat-related factors to form sample data, and used to train the improved BP neural network. Finally, through the comparative analysis of test samples, predicted the trend of new samples. The results show that the method is reasonable in predicting the forwarding rate, response rate and comment rate of blog posts, which provides a good reference for heat prediction of blog post.

articleTitle: Position Sensorless Technology Considering Inductance Saturation Effects of SRMs
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The phase inductance parameter of switched reluctance motor (SRM) is an important parameter to control the operation of the motor. In fact, the inductance parameter is indirectly calculated by the flux linkage characteristics of the motor. Aiming at the flux estimation error obtained from the analysis, a stator loop equivalent resistance calibration method to correct the flux estimation error is proposed. Finally, the optimized inductance parameters are obtained through data analysis and processing. The experimental results show that this method is simple and efficient, and can realize the high-performance control of SRM.

articleTitle: Fat or thin? A study on the influence of body type of service robots on human-robot interaction willingness
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Purpose - Previous research has explored the effect of anthropomorphic service robot appearance (e.g., facial features, humanoid musculoskeletal morphology, etc.) on willingness to use. However, service robots in different service contexts have different body types, and few studies have examined the relationship between different body types and interaction willingness. Therefore, this study aims to investigate which body type (thin vs. fat) can more effectively influence consumers' willingness to interact. Design/methodology/approach - Two experiments were done involving 405 randomly selected online participants using an experimental behavioral method. Study 1 used a one-factor between-subject design (service robot body type: thin vs. fat) to explore the effects of body type on willingness to interact and the mediating mechanism of perceived value. Study 2 used a 2 (body type: thin vs. fat) ×2 (relationship role: companion vs. colleague) between-subjects design to analyze the moderation mechanism. Findings - Study 1 shows that thin service robots increase consumers' perceived value compared to fat service robots, positively influencing consumers' willingness to interact with service robots. Study 2 indicated that participants were more willing to interact with fat (vs. thin) service robots when the service robots played the role of companions (vs. colleagues). Additionally, the moderating effect of the relationship role was also moderated by the relationship strength. The stronger the relationship between the individual and the service robot, the more the service robot as a colleague enhances the individual's willingness to interact with the fat service robot. Originality/value - This study brings implications for the literature on service robot anthropomorphism and the designing of service robots.

articleTitle: Intelligent Justice Based on Cognitive Science and IT
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Wisdom is the exclusive nature of human consciousness and one of the signs of human beings. In addition to the Internet+, big data and artificial intelligence which are computer technology as the physical basis, it's cognitive basis, operation mode and purpose effect involved in Intelligent Justice are all based on the premise and reference of cognitive science. Therefore, the Intelligent Justice based on data and algorithms is an imitation of some human functions, which ultimately is mainly to provide services for human beings. In view of this, explaining the cognitive basis of Intelligent Justice is of great theoretical significance for understanding the construction of Intelligent Justice. Starting from the development of cognitive science, it can be further discussed for Intelligent Justice which simulates human cognitive mode regarding IT as the core, and the limitations and transcendence compared with human cognition can be clarified.

articleTitle: A Structurally Constrained Informer for UWB Positioning Distance Filtering Used in Speed-Skating Training
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Scientific training for location and trajectory tracking technology is a necessary technical condition in speed skating project, this paper studies the crucial data filtering technique for achieving a good trade-off between system cost and the positioning accuracy based on UWB positioning method. This paper focuses on the problem of localization signal blocking caused by metal reflection in large stadiums, and an improved trajectory filtering method based on Transformer model has been proposed with adjusted novel structural constraints. Compared with the traditional Kalman filtering method, our proposed method achieves prediction accuracy improvement up to 68%, and compared with the original Informer model, the prediction accuracy is improved by 19%. It makes it possible to track accurate positions and generate trajectory information in crowded and intense race conditions.

articleTitle: A class of inverse eigenvalue problems for bifurcation matrices
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this paper, we study the eigenvalue inverse problem for a class of bifurcation matrices. The existence of a unique identity of the matrix is obtained for two given pairs of eigenvalues. Several cases are discussed to obtain expressions for the solution, and numerical examples are used to illustrate the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Edible fungi quality and safety traceability management system
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In recent years, food safety incidents have occurred continuously, and quality safety traceability has become an important means to ensure food safety. This paper analyzes the industrial production process of edible fungi, and the quality and safety traceability management system of edible fungi based on Web was established. The system uses ASP.NET, EAN/UCC-128 coding and XML data exchange technology to realize the quality control of edible fungi production process. Consumers can query the source information of edible mushroom products through this system. Such as edible fungus production information and processing information. The system is also helpful to the risk management and control of edible fungus production enterprises, to minimize the risk in the production process. The practice results show that, the system can meet the whole process quality tracking requirements of edible fungi products.

articleTitle: Integration and Research of the Multifunctional Geological Survey Information Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In traditional geological surveys, the compass, GPS and record forms are usually used as tools. However, these tools are time-consuming and less efficient, and bring certain inconvenience to the field survey work. In addition, misoperations may occur during data acquisition and processing as well, seriously affecting the quality of survey data. With the development of mobile communication technologies, the computing and processing performance of intelligent mobile terminals is getting more and more powerful, and they are basically integrated with hardware devices such as the GPS, gyroscope and high-definition camera. The integration of GPS, gyroscope and close-range photogrammetry contributes to the establishment of the field geological survey data acquisition system that can quickly acquire distance and spatial position information and fill in the information. By making full use of intelligent mobile terminals to solve the problem of data acquisition and recording during the traditional field geological survey, an App, i.e.the mobile terminal-based field geological survey data acquisition system was developed, which can improve the field survey and indoor data collation efficiency. In this study, The field geological survey acquisition system(APP) based on the Android operating platform was developed, using dart2.9.0 as the client development language, python3. 7.7 as the server-side development language and MySQL6.0 as the database. With the system, the coordinate measurement (single-point positioning and remote telemetry), the attitude measurement, length measurement, photography and information reporting and other functions can be realized, which improves the accuracy of field geological surveys, increases the work efficiency and control quality, and realizes the whole-process supervision and log recording.

articleTitle: Study on Heat Effect Mechanism and Rules of Crankshaft Bearing of Internal Combustion Engine
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This paper establishes thermal elastohydro-dynamics (TEHD) calculation model of crankshaft main bearing of internal combustion engine based on average Reynolds equation and dynamic adaptation equation considering asperity contact, analyzes its lubrication and friction characteristics, discusses mechanism of heat generation and heat exchange, and acquires corresponding effect law. Results show: most main bearings are in status of mixture lubrication, and generate heat through asperity contact and viscous friction; heat dissipation proportion of lubricating oil is 24.4%, and temperature rises 23.5°; as explosion pressure increases, power consumption is larger, oil temperature lowers, and minimum oil film thickness is reduced; while when oil supply pressure changes, the law of function is opposite.

articleTitle: Big-data-based Research on Forecast and Early Warning against Mass Incidents
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the further development of reformation and opening-up on a continuous basis, the transformation of economic system and social structure and the redistribution of social wealth give rise to an unprecedented high occurrence of Mass Incidents posing a threat endangering social stability. With a focus on how to effectively and automatically label potential social events scattered in various functional departments and identify potential Mass Incidents in time, this paper attempts to identify the potential Mass Incidents based on Time Series by identifying the Semantic Entity Recognition of names of the place, the people and the organization involved in the potential social events within a specific region. The result indicates that the Semantic Entity Recognition based on social events data and its Time Series Quantitative Analysis Model are of great significance to improve the capability for forecast and early warning against social security risks.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Game Analysis of Collaborative Emergency Response among Government Departments under Accident and Disaster
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Different from other fields that introduce sharding algorithm and Byzantine fault-tolerant algorithm on the basis of evolutionary game to determine the security and stability of the system, In order to improve the efficiency of the collaborative emergency among government departments in accidents and disasters while avoiding the imbalance of losses and gains among departments, Building an evolutionary game model under the vertical incentive mechanism and analyzing the behavioral decisions and evolutionary paths among departments. The influence of different factors on the evolutionary equilibrium state of the system is investigated by numerical analysis, The results show that the stability of the behavioral strategies of government departments is closely related to the benefits and costs and the vertical incentive policy of both sides of the game, under certain conditions, the larger the vertical incentive, the more government departments tend to respond actively to the accident and disaster, while too small vertical incentive makes government departments tend to choose a negative response strategy.

articleTitle: Noise Reduction Method Based on Wavelet Analysis for RF side-channel Signals
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The emergence of the RF side-channel leakage problem in 2018 reveals a significant hidden danger of wireless communication system, meanwhile, because the signal is in the wireless channel, making the collected RF side-channel leakage curve inevitably has the interference of noise, which affects the effectiveness of RF side-channel analysis. In order to reduce the influence of noise, this paper proposes a noise reduction algorithm based on wavelet filtering for RF side-channel signals, and achieves pre-processing of the leakage curve by collecting the leakage curve in a noisy environment, filtering, aligning and noise reduction operations on the curve, and successfully obtains the key information of the target device through key analysis. According to the experimental results, the method can improve the success rate of key analysis.

articleTitle: Research on remote guidance of hardware operation and maintenance of computer room based on AR
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: At present, AR remote guidance used in computer room operation and maintenance inspection usually uses circle annotation and arrow as annotation guidance. The guidance of operation mode is not clear enough, and primary operation and maintenance personnel are still difficult to understand. Therefore, a remote guidance method of computer room hardware operation and maintenance based on 3D dynamic editing AR is proposed. The 3D model of computer room hardware is used as the scene basis, the experts edit, annotate the model remotely. Finally, the dynamic operation guidance is sent to the AR display device of the field operator to form the AR dynamic operation guidance of the virtual and real fusion. The experimental results using this method show that the 3D remote annotation can effectively realize the AR remote guidance. Compared with the screenshot operation guidance, the guidance efficiency and accuracy are higher, and the field operators receive better information.

articleTitle: Radiation Emission Test and Rectification Analysis of the Three-Dimensional Electronic Laparoscopy System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The three-dimensional electronic laparoscopy processes the collected signals through the endoscope imager processing host, and uses the three-dimensional imaging algorithm to transmit the image information to the 3D display and the 2D display. As the structure of this system is complex, the phenomenon that the radiation value exceeds the standard is prone to occur. In this study, such phenomenon occurring during the electromagnetic compatibility test was analyzed and different rectification measures were taken to solve the problem that the radiation emission exceeding the standard in the three-dimensional electronic laparoscopy system.

articleTitle: An outdoor sheltered parking space detection system combined with drone and GNSS-RTK technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of the existing parking space detection system or detection technology, proposed and preliminarily realized a kind of quad-roder UAV as a mobile platform, supplemented by GNSS-RTK high-precision satellite positioning, and image recognition technology's parking space detection system. An artificial neural network is used in the system to complete the real-time detection of the parking space image in the airborne computer, and then only need to send the detection results back to the ground for announce. Can be used for sheltered outdoor parking lots, and when used in parking lots of the same size, the deployment cost is the existing system's 1/4~ 1/12. Due to the natural high noise immunity of neural networks, and the relative fixity of the use of the scene, with the support of GNSS-RTK technology, it is passed Self-developed parallel anti-offset positioning algorithm, has been able to achieve nearly 100% detection accuracy, positioning and landing accuracy has been controlled within 0.25m, and (in the fastest case) can completed detection of 300 parking spaces within 20 minutes by a single UAV, the timeliness requirements are basically achieved.

articleTitle: Establishment of Teaching Diagnosis and Improvement System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The development of the education industry has been greatly boosted by the age of Big Data. Big Data with a large amount of information operation has been proposed and applied in the teaching of higher vocational colleges, which is both an opportunity and a challenge for teaching diagnosis and improvement of higher vocational colleges. To improve the quality of teaching and talent cultivation, Beijing Polytechnic established a big data-based teaching diagnosis and improvement system, extracted data from the school information system and diagnosed and analyzed the data on five levels, i.e., levels of the college, the major, the curriculum, the teaching staff, and the students. At the same time, a complete education mechanism and guarantee sub-sytem was set up to ensure the school-level and relevant departments handle the problems properly and promptly. Now, the system has been working for 2 years and and has achieved remarkable results.

Author Keywords: Five Horizontal and Five Vertical Strategies

articleTitle: Application of Matlab Robust Control Toolbox for Wind Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the randomness of the wind speed change, the wind turbine torque disturbance, high-frequency unmodeled uncertainties in wind power generation system, use loop-shaping algorithm on system design of robust controller after forming. In this paper, the local linear model for the wind energy conversion system is established. Through the design and simulation of robust control toolbox in matlab and using Hankel singular value to reduce the order. Simulation results show that using robust control toolbox functions the simplified controller design is able to replace the original controller well.

articleTitle: Pig Face Recognition Method Based on Sparse Representation, Transfer Learning and Weight fusionPaper
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Because the pig face features of different individuals are similar and have little difference, if the pre-processed pig face data set is input into the shallow network for training, it is easy to lose the detail features, while blindly deepening the network layers will lead to sudden increase of parameters, disappearance or explosion of gradients and over-fitting. Study the pig face feature deep learning network, build 32-layer and 50-layer networks, share the use weight among residual modules, and add Batch Normalization (BN) algorithm to the residual module, which makes the deep learning network easier to converge and inhibit over-fitting. The root-based weight fusion scheme combines the sparse representation results of the original samples and the new class samples to achieve high recognition rate for small sample data sets.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Detection Based on Dynamic Truck Scale
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: This paper introduces a dynamic truck scale and its compulsory verification. In order to solve the problems encountered in the dynamic truck scale inspection process, a dynamic truck scale detection software is designed and developed, and the F2×16 wireless data transmission module is used to build a dynamic truck scale. The truck scale intelligent detection system realizes the intelligent detection of dynamic truck scales. It not only solves the problems of low detection efficiency in the forced inspection process, inconvenient data storage and query, and low data security, but also provides a reference for the intelligent promotion of dynamic truck scale detection.

articleTitle: Application of EV_SCMW V2.0 of Easymoo in College Classroom
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: EV_SCMW V2.0 of Easymoo is a set of software for simulating actual combat sand table confrontation. It is mainly used in college practical and enterprise internal training and has apparent characteristics of enriching classroom content and improving teaching. Based on years of practical combat and teaching experience, the author summarizes a set of multi-dimensional methods to maximize the teaching effect of the platform from the aspects of product characteristics, training objectives, software applications, and hardware environment configuration, and puts forward the best selection scheme for the current common teaching environment of promoting teaching and learning through competition in China.

articleTitle: A new association rule mining method and its application in mental health data analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: A lot of employees are plagued by all kinds of mental health problems. Mental health problems brought a lot of negative effects to them. Therefore, it is particularly important to find key laws by analyzing mental health data. Association rule algorithm can mine the potential relationship between the elements hidden in massive data, which is often used in data analysis in various fields. In this paper, we apply it to the analysis of mental health data in order to mine the correlation between various symptom factors and provide data-based scientific support for psychologists or relevant practitioners. However, traditional association rule mining algorithms will still produce a large number of redundant results even when the support or confidence is high enough, which undoubtedly adds obstacles to decision-makers in discovering key information. Therefore, in this paper, we propose a freely filterable association rule mining method, which can better locate the target results. Experimental results show that our method can mine association rules accurately among the various mental factors, and these rules can play a guiding role in the psychological construction of various organizations for their employees.

articleTitle: Research on Reverse Pulsating Hydrodynamic Deep Drawing Based on Numerical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In this work, a cylindrical part with the concave bottom is manufactured by the forming process of reverse pulsating hydrodynamic deep drawing. The finite element simulation is used to obtain the thickness distribution and investigate the complex deformation behaviour of the part. The effect of loading path on the part profile and the wall thickness variation of the part is studied during the whole forming process. The concave bottom height and thickness distribution by reverse pulsating hydrodynamic deep drawing are compared with the traditional hydrodynamic deep drawing process. The result shows that the concave bottom height and the minimum thickness of the cylindrical part could be increased by 51.7% and 104%, respectively. The material in the flange could be significantly shifted to the concave bottom of the cylindrical part by the reverse pulsating hydrodynamic deep drawing. Therefore, the value of thickness reduction could be increased at the easily ruptured position, to obtain high the concave bottom of cylindrical part.

Author Keywords: cylindrical part with the concave bottom

articleTitle: Based on BIM technology in the construction phase of the application of traffic evacuation
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the rapid development of urban economy, urban viaduct traffic is the trend of development, urban construction of viaduct projects are more and more, but the construction of viaduct projects also face the problem of traffic relief in the construction stage., therefore, need to be looking for the way of traffic organization has been optimized construction stage, with BIM technology in construction stage, to simulate the traffic organization of data through computer modeling and simulation technology will be the actual traffic situation was simulated, and then through the simulation results to optimize the construction phase of the problem of traffic organization, in this article, through the simulation method and practical case for analysis, It provides a reference for the subsequent research.

articleTitle: An Optimization Algorithm for the Game of NoGo based on MCTS
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The game of NoGo has been proposed in recent years. NoGo game and its related rules are firstly introduce. Then we discuss the problems exposed by the traditional MCTS algorithm at the beginning of the game, proposes an idea of creating a converse digraph and solves the shortcomings of the traditional MCTS (Monte-Carlo Tree Search) algorithm at the beginning of the game. Finally, the NoGo result between the proposed algorithm by this paper and other traditional algorithm is obtained. The experimental result show that our proposed algorithm are practical for NoGo.

articleTitle: Analysis of Enterprise Technological Innovation Research Based on Multiple Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to investigate enterprise technology innovation decisions based on the co-determining mechanism of the directors and executive-employee pay gap, drawing on Tournament Theory and Upper Echelon Theory. The sample is an unbalanced panel dataset consisting of 806 firm-year observations selected from A-share listed companies belonging to the AI Industry in Shanghai and Shenzhen Stock Exchange of China during 2016–2019. The empirical result suggests that executive-employee pay gap intend to inhibit the investment in technology innovation based on multiple regression model. Rich robustness and endogeneity tests confirm the above findings.

articleTitle: The study of intelligent poetry writing robots
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the content of the poem is inconsistent with the writing intention of the poem at this stage and is not enough to express the author's mood and mood, the Encoder-Decoder model, Transformer, python programming language, and the pycharm development tool are used to realize a poetry writing robot system, and the automatic writing of the poetry writing robot is completed, and only one line needs to be entered to automatically generate a poem that is neat and tidy, and the function of a good mood is automatically generated. The central idea and theme of the written poems are more clear, the content and creative mood expressed in the story are more unified, and the poetry writing system designed to protect traditional culture in the literary industry and promote the development of cultural treasures - ancient poetry has been widely used.

articleTitle: Parallel Collision Detection Algorithms in Complex Scenes
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In current research, collision detection technology has become more and more important, and conflict information is also a problem worth exploring. In order to obtain the information in time and make effective judgment, it is necessary to design corresponding algorithms to deal with the conflicts generated in these complex environments. From the perspective of utilizing the parallel computing power of multiprocessors, a parallel fast collision detection algorithm is proposed. Based on the mixed bounding box hierarchy tree, the algorithm traverses the mixed bounding box hierarchy in parallel by adopting the OpenMP parallel model. The experimental results show that the parallelization of OpenMP significantly improves the speed of the collision detection algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on geological structure characteristics of Lamadian oilfield test area based on gptmap software
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: To address the problem that the description of geological structure features in the North North Block test area of Lama Dian oil field is not accurate and comprehensive. GPTMap reservoir automatic mapping software was used to map the reservoir structural features, sedimentation features, well location map, compartment development status and oil formation connectivity status and control degree based on well logging data into a cloud map. The results show that gptmap reservoir mapping software has the characteristics of comprehensive function coverage, high work efficiency and rich image color, solves the problem of graphic reuse, and realizes the two-dimensional and three-dimensional reproduction of reservoir geological data;The structure of the test area is relatively gentle, gradually steepening from west to East, and the dip angle of the stratum is between 5º~,6°, plunging northward at 3°~4°;The target oil layer belongs to river delta sedimentation, which is mainly a low bend distributary channel sedimentary model in flood distributary plain environment. It has the characteristics of more intervals, larger thickness and complex sedimentary model;After subdividing the sedimentary units, the interlayer between the sedimentary units is mainly class I mudstone interlayer, and the penetration rate is between 36.7% ~ 89.0%; The overall sand body is mainly connected between channel sand body and channel sand body; The plane heterogeneity of the reservoir is strong, and the permeability difference between wells is large. The detailed description of the geological conditions of the test area provides a geological basis for the formulation of subsequent development plans.

articleTitle: Analyses of Laser Action Distance and Echo Influence Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: When used for ranging, positioning, guidance, communication and tactical weapons, the military requires not only accurate measurement of the effective area of the laser spot and the target, but also requires the laser guidance head to detect the guidance laser with a high probability of detection and track the target with high tracking accuracy, so it is important to study the angular tracking error of the laser guidance head on the target.
