In this paper, we explore the ground laser in a certain horizontal orientation, high and low tracking error in the direction of laser emission, laser beam transmission through the atmospheric environment to the target location, in the atmospheric transmission process the laser energy will be attenuated through the atmospheric transmittance. At this time the spot will intersect the target, in order to facilitate theoretical analysis, the target area equivalent to the circular area, through the atmospheric attenuation, the target intersection area and the role of distance expressions, the return energy is calculated. The detection capability of the laser system is determined by parameters such as laser detector transmitting power, divergence angle, receiving power, optical system transmittance, scope structure and detector detection capability, etc. The action distance is affected by atmospheric conditions, the size of the target reflective area, target reflectivity and visibility, etc., and is finally supplemented by simulation tests.

articleTitle: Optimizing Energy Consumption of Rotor UAV by Path Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Rotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) have been widely used in daily life due to their portability, flexibility, and low cost. However, the limited endurance of rotor UAV becomes the bottleneck in various applications. Optimization of UAV energy consumption by path planning is the primary energy consumption optimization. The energy consumption of rotor UAVs depends not only on the flight distance but also on the speed and the number of turns they take. In this paper, we formulate the rotor UAV path planning as a traveling salesman problem to optimize rotor UAV energy consumption. We propose an improved sine and cosine algorithm based on opposition-based learning (SCAO) to solve the optimization problem.

articleTitle: Automatic Measurement Method of Human Body Dimension Based on Frontal Human Image
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to better acquire the human body dimension required for clothing size selection or clothing customization, an automatic measurement method of three-dimensional human body dimension based on frontal human body image is proposed. Taking the female body image as the research object, based on the height, weight and frontal body image, the feature points of the image were identified and the two-dimensional feature dimensions were extracted, and then the neural network prediction model based on machine learning training was used to calculate body dimensions. Through error analysis and practical verification, the results showed that the average measurement error of each dimension met the tolerance requirements of clothing production, which indicated that this measurement method could quickly and effectively obtain the human body dimension through the frontal human body image.

articleTitle: Natural Neighbor Galerkin Method for Electromagnetic Field Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Considering the fact that non-Sibsonian interpolation in natural neighbor Galerkin method (NNGM) is simpler and more efficient than Sibson interpolation in natural element method (NEM), in the present paper NNGM is introduced into electromagnetic field analysis, and two typical electrostatic 2D examples are analyzed. The numerical results agree well with the analytical solutions, which reveal that NNGM can be used to analyze the electromagnetic field problems.

articleTitle: Two-factor Lightweight Mutual Authentication Protocol For Multiple Servers
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Recently, fifth-generation (5G) wireless networks have been used in some areas and will soon expand rapidly, compared with single-server architecture, multi-server architecture is more suitable for 5G network. Most of the existing authentication protocols have some security problems, such as unable to resist identity guessing attack, password guessing attack and impersonation attack. This paper will propose a lightweight authentication protocol based on elliptic curve cryptography (ECC). The proposed authentication protocol is not only anonymous, but also can resist various attacks.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Score Model of Suppliers of Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Aiming at the business needs of power grid companies to score their suppliers' credit, this paper uses logistic regression algorithm as a technical means to build a credit scoring model for power grid companies' suppliers.In this paper, data cleaning and feature extraction are first performed on the training data set of power grid enterprise suppliers. Afterwards, it is trained by the LogisticRegression class in the machine learning library sklearn. The test results show that the detection accuracy of this test is 0.78. The construction of the credit scoring model is suitable for the industry characteristics of power grid companies. However, there is a problem that the credit score is inaccurate due to the lack of authority and uniformity of the evaluation criteria in the training data.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Big Data Technology on Chinese Phonology
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Chinese, as a language, has developed for thousands of years. Not only the shape and meaning of the characters have changed, but also the pronunciation has changed a lot. In order to deeply reveal the evolution law of Chinese language and pronunciation, and to realize the innovation and breakthrough of Chinese phonology research methods, we use big data technology to compare and analyze the materials of ancient Chinese pronunciation “Pingshui Rhyme” with that of modern Chinese pronunciation “Chinese New Rhyme”. The results of experiments are basically consistent with the results of traditional research methods. And the big data technology is efficient and accurate, which is conducive to discovering deep rules in the study of Chinese language and phonetics.

articleTitle: The Structure Parameters and Molecular Orbital Energy of Procyanidins were Calculated by Quantum Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Proanthocyanidins have been widely used in various fields such as pharmaceuticals, health products and cosmetics, etc. In this paper, the structure of chemical proanthocyanidins was optimized and calculated by the method of DFT/B3LYP/6-31G, which laid the foundation for further research on the mechanism of antioxidant activity of proanthocyanidins in different pH aqueous solutions, and also provided some reference data for improving the performance of anthocyanidins by modifying their structures.

articleTitle: An algorithm of root extraction is not applicable
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Groch, Hofheinz, and Steinwandt proposed a simple heuristic approach in [4] to the root problem in braid groups. articleTitle: Indoor Location Method Based on RSSI Probability Distribution and CSI Modified Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Fingerprint matching is one of the mainstream indoor positioning methods based on wireless signals. In this paper., we extracted the RSSI probability distribution and CSI amplitude from RSSI and CSI respectively as signal fingerprints. The RSSI probability distribution and CSI modified model were established by integrating the two signal fingerprints., and an indoor localization method based on the RSSI probability distribution and CSI modified model was proposed. Experimental results show that the proposed method has better positioning accuracy and anti-noise ability than traditional fingerprint matching method., especially in complex indoor environment.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Hand Spatial Position Predictor Based on Data Gloves and Jetson Xavier NX
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Based on the functional design of the hand rehabilitation index evaluator for patients with clinical hemiplegia and hand dysfunction, as well as the design based on the function of gesture recognition and sign language translation for the deaf, this paper applies a wireless wearable data glove based on inertial sensors, combined with the current NVIDIA most advanced edge computing development platform Jetson Xavier conducts artificial intelligence development and applications. A database of sensor data and hand joint angle and spatial position information is established by using the sensor data obtained by the data glove. A recurrent neural network with continuous prediction function is then trained using deep learning based on this database and deployed on the Jetson Xavier development platform. Finally, the sensor data is transmitted to the platform through the wireless communication module for real-time reasoning based on deep learning neural network, and the role of artificial intelligence in predicting the angle and spatial position of hand joints is realized.

articleTitle: A Method for Evaluating Reliability and Failure Rate of DC Circuit Breakers
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: At present, the research on the design rationality and operation reliability of DC circuit breakers is one of the urgent problems to be solved in developing DC transmission and distribution network. Markov model has also been widely used in load forecasting and reliability evaluation of microgrid. Taking the characteristics of failure rate and availability as parameters, this study proposed a Markov model-based reliability evaluation method of DC circuit breakers. By calculating and comparing the failure rate and reliability index, the reliability difference of circuit breakers with different topological structures was predicted. The results showed that this method could describe the random probability of the overall state transition of DC circuit breakers, predict its transition process from stable state to fault state, and find weak links in time. In addition, it could assist in designing DC circuit breakers through the weak link analysis and redundancy analysis.

articleTitle: Acoustic detection of concrete compactness of Multi cavity steel box concrete composite structures
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: As for the multi cavity steel box composite structure and the steel and concrete composite structure, the casting quality of concrete and the combination of mixed interface between steel and concrete have a great influence on the bearing capacity and the use safety of buildings. Because of that, the detection of concrete compactness and interface between steel and concrete is very important, but there is no definite report on how to detect these defects accurately so far. A 1:1 full-scale test with different dimentions of artificial quality defects set inside the steel box was carried out, aimed to simulate the concrete quality defects and study the effectiveness of several detection methods. The compactness of the concrete was tested by acoustic detection, and compared with the actual core drilling detection, the effect of acoustic detection on concrete compactness test of the steel box concrete composite structure was determined.

articleTitle: Visual analysis and frontier predictions of industrial big data
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: With the numerous development and continuous optimization of industrial technology, industrial big data is faced with the challenge of massive volume, multi-source, and heterogeneity. Industrial big data achievements present an exponential trend of growth because of the development strategy of national industry. Currently, massive scholars devote themselves to industrial big data researches, but the consistency of analysis and management on industrial big data results is inadequate, especially with the assistance of bibliometrics methods and visualization tools to intuitively and systematically demonstrate the regularity and value of data. It uses CiteSpace to conduct bibliometric analysis on the published literature (1901–2020) from the Web of Science Core Collection with a subject search related to industrial big data. In total, 1352 papers are synthetically reviewed by collaboration networks and co-citation networks involving countries, institutions, authors, journals, keywords, references. The objection of this study is to reveal the present status and potential frontiers for researchers in the field of industrial big data, providing them with valuable information and efficient guidance.

articleTitle: Yield Loss Estimation of Verticillium Wilt Cotton Field Based on UAV Multi-spectral and Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: otton Verticillium wilt, as one of the important diseases of cotton, poses a huge threat to the yield and quality of cotton fields. Estimate the yield loss caused by Verticillium wilt of cotton by using the UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) multispectral model can provide reference for estimating yield loss caused by crop diseases. This study used UAV multi-spectral platform to obtain the image of cotton disease in the experimental area, combined with the ground data by manual investigation, to select the vegetation index and the best band combination with the strongest correlation and optimum exponential factor with cotton disease, then construct the UAV multispectral index. Four classes regression models which from multiple linear regression (MLR), partial least squares regression (PLSR), principal component analysis (PCA) and support vector machine (SVM) were constructed to estimate the cotton yield loss caused by cotton disease based on UAV multispectral index and cotton disease yield loss data. The UAV multispectral images to identify disease of cotton best vegetation index, the best band combination were DVI (I r |=0.86), and (B3-B5-B8) (OIF value = 153.44), respectively. and build the best UAV multispectral index was (RB3-B5-BS + DVI). The four regression models constructed based on UAV multispectral index (RB3-B5-Bs+DVI) can better estimate the yield loss of cotton field with disease. The R2 of four regression monitoring models was between 0.57–0.64, RMSE difference was 6.02, R2 of the validation set was between 0.66 and 0.84.RMSE difference was 15.32, the difference was small. The multivariate linear regression model constructed by UAV multi-spectral index (RB3-B5-Bs+DV)I had the highest verification accuracy (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>=0.84, RMSE=30.73), which could be used as the best estimation model for U A V multi-spectral monitoring of cotton yield loss caused by diseases.

articleTitle: An improved forward intersection measurement strategy based on structural parameters for machine vision systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Conventional forward intersection measurement methods in close-range photogrammetry depend on on-site calibrations with aids of control points or parameters from other categories of visual sensors in an object coordinate system. This may restrict the wider adoption of machine vision system. To address these limitations, two key structural parameters were set for expressing the visual-related vectors and for building a measurement coordinate system located on carrier. Two categories of co-spherical resection algorithms were established to calibrate the two key structural parameters based on the resection of principal optic axes in their normal directions. A new parameter vector model was proposed for the collinear equation of co-spherical resection, in which three points on a principal optic axis were included, they are principal target point, perspective point, and tangent point. The vectors for the improved forward intersection measurement were expressed by structural parameters, optical parameters, and posture value of the camera in the measurement coordinate system. Experimental results demonstrated that the calibrations of the two structural parameters by the two co-spherical resection algorithms were both accurate, and the improved forward intersection strategy was effective. The strategy not only dispenses with on-site calibrations, but also achieves satisfactory measurement accuracy on both the spatial plane targets and the plant leaves. The parameter vector model, the two structural parameters, the two co-spherical resection algorithms, and the improved forward intersection strategy hope to be applied to machine-vision platforms with multi-degrees of freedom to facilitate control of robots.

articleTitle: A Review on Cloud Data Assured Deletion
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: At present, cloud service providers control the direct management rights of cloud data, and cloud data cannot be effectively and assured deleted, which may easily lead to security problems such as data residue and user privacy leakage. This paper analyzes the related research work of cloud data assured deletion in recent years from three aspects: encryption key deletion, multi-replica association deletion, and verifiable deletion. The advantages and disadvantages of various deletion schemes are analysed in detail, and finally the prospect of future research on assured deletion of cloud data is given.

articleTitle: Research on Testing Method of Automobile Engine Performance Parameters Based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The testing of engine parameters is the basis for correct evaluation and judgment of engine performance. The accuracy of the data testing directly affects the accuracy of the evaluation. Based on LabViewsoftware development platform, the test method reflecting engine performance parameters was researched, and a new portable tester was developed to test the conventional parameters such as cylinder pressure, exhaust temperature, acceleration, speed and vibration. The instrument is composed of sensors and data acquisition cards, which can achieve accurate acquisition of the measured data and display it intuitively with a friendly interface. It meets the demand for accurate acquisition of engine performance parameters. Its software is the core. When the test conditions change, the research method can be updated quickly. The software is easy to maintain, and it has a broad application prospect in the testing field.

articleTitle: The Birth of a New Theoretical System of Physics in the 21st Century Will Usher in a New Era of Interstellar Space Flying Saucer Research
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: According to the article “New Theoretical System of Physics in the 21st Century” published by the author; It is proposed to use the “scientific principle” of the “balanced distance” between “gravity” and “repulsion” between “planets” to “research” - “space flying saucer”. This paper reviews the new theoretical system's understanding of the universal gravitational and repulsive forces between substances(star ball), as well as the understanding of the”equilibrium distance law of attraction and repulsion” between substances(star ball); and puts forward the formula of the “universal repulsive force law” between substances. Under the guidance of the new theoretical system, the relationship between the “discharge flying saucer” emitting electric field and the earth's emitting electric field is studied; it is expounded that “discharge flying saucer” is equivalent to a planet; According to the principle of mutual attraction and repulsion between planets; Explains the reasons why the flying saucer has the following characteristics: Flying Saucers can fly at high speed, change direction immediately, hover at any height on the earth, and there is no sound when flying. This article proposed the research plan of “space flying saucer”; Finally, the scientific significance of the new theoretical system is expounded: speeding up the research process of “space flying saucer” can change the fate of mankind's self-destruction due to large-scale nuclear war; Therefore, the development of discharge flying saucer imminent; With the new theory of physics in the 21st century advocated by the author The birth of the system will usher in an era of interstellar “space flying saucer” research!

articleTitle: Swarm Robots Decentralized Control using Reinforcement Learning Stepwise Training Method in the Encircling Task
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: We consider a special multiple-robot task, pursuit-evasion (PE) game, in which a swarm of hunting robots (Pursuers) attempts to encircle a target robot (Evader) in a two-dimensional plane with some fixed obstacles on it. Instead of the central control method, we suggest a fully decentralized pursuit strategy generated by the deep reinforcement learning (DRL) which has greatly advanced the research in decision-making field in recent years. While the DRL method in this encircling task faces a sparse reward and a nonconvex space challenge which makes convergence result unacceptable. In this article, we have clarified the definition of a successful encirclement by escaping angel. In order to overcome the inefficient exploration and premature convergence caused by the above challenges during the training process, we use a stepwise training method of an adaptive various reward function. All prosecutors use the same policy given by stepwise training method and the multi-agent deep deterministic policy gradient (MADDPG) algorithms. Simulations and comparisons are provided to validate the effectiveness of this work.

articleTitle: Prediction and evaluation of the SARS-CoV-2 epidemic using an improved SEIR model
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The present work propose an improved SEIR model that considers isolation and repeated nucleic acid detection factors. It was applied to the Kashgar Region, Xinjiang, China, to predict the changing trend of the number of confirmed cases and the number of susceptible individuals in Kashgar, and to evaluate and analyze local policy interventions. Model perform four predictive analyses of the epidemic situation in Kashgar. Comprehensive nucleic acid testing, isolation of asymptomatic patients, increasing isolation time and different proportions of the population isolated, control of population flow. Improved kinetic parameters were obtained using the Monte Carlo method. The theoretical estimation of the epidemic using the improved SEIR infectious disease dynamics model was in good agreement with the actuality of the epidemic in Kashgar. The analysis showed that in the areas with large area and dense population, repeat nucleic acid detection, quarantine of asymptomatic individuals and control the contact rate between people can quickly and effectively inhibit development of the local epidemic.

articleTitle: A Novel Visual Assisted Technique for Video Summarization Using Attention-Based Key-Frames Selection
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The advancements in digital videos led to new demands and novel research opportunities. Many tools and methods are developed over time for efficient video browsing. One of the widespread methods is to extract keyframes to generate summary of the video that present the complete message of the video. The video summarization uses visual attention model, in which noteworthy frames are extracted as a keyframe based on human attention model. It is a workable solution for video summarization, however high computational cost limits its application in practical scenario. In this paper, we propose a novel keyframe extraction (KFE) method based on improved visual attention model. The computational cost and expensive calculations are minimised by utilising dynamic visual highlights that are based on the temporal gradient as an alternative of the conventional optical flow procedures. Secondly, introducing an effective method by means of a discrete cosine conversion is utilised for the static visual salience. Moreover, static and dynamic visual attention system of measurements are combined through a nonlinear weighted fusion method. The practical outcomes show that proposed method is efficient and high standard for the video summarization.

articleTitle: A forward intersection strategy on structural parameters for robotic vision system with 3 or more DOFs
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: The vision-based measurement for robot with 3 or more degrees of freedom (DOFs) require on-site calibrations and auxiliary sensors to establish an object coordinate system at present. Obviously, it is time consuming and requires extensive computing resources, and these hinder the application of vision-based measurement for robot in many fields. To solve these questions, a measurement coordinate system on robot was established according to the posture of robotic parts in preset position, structure of robot and vision system. Two categories of structural parameters were proposed; posture transformation matrices of robotic parts from the preset posture to an actual posture were built; and the visual-related spatial vectors were expressed by the two categories of structural parameters, optical parameters, and posture matrices in the measurement coordinate system. According to these, a new forward intersection strategy is proposed for robotic vision system. The new structural parameters for vision system on robot were proven to be reliable. The expressions of the visual-related vectors for robot were found to be correct and effective. Experimental results demonstrated that the new forward intersection strategy was accurate and efficient, and this strategy can be applied to robotic vision platforms to facilitate control of robots.

articleTitle: Multi-Scale Attribute-Based Attention For Fine-Grained Zero-Shot Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Zero-shot recognition achieves the classification of unseen classes by aligning the visual features and semantic information of images, while the global features extracted by zero-shot learning method are not enough to classify fine-grained classes. Firmed at the foregoing shortages, we put forward a multi-scale attribute-based attention network that captures local feature differences between fine-grained categories and improves the extraction efficiency of different scale attributes. Instead of aligning global visual features with the associated class semantic features, we achieve this by embedding each attribute which aims to pay more attention to the regions most related to the attribute. To this end, we adjust the contribution to prediction of each attribute by using multi-layered attention mechanism. Moreover, we design a new joint calibration loss to solve the distribution deviation problem caused by ignoring the clustering between coarse-grained classes in the fine-grained classification process. We perform experiments on several popular classical datasets of CUB, SUN and AWA2, demonstrating that our proposed framework works better than existing methods.

articleTitle: Application Analysis of Computer-aided Technology in the Field of Tube Cold Rolling
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: There are many factors affecting the tube rolling process, which will ultimately affect the quality of the finished tubes. The traditional tube rolling research adopts on-site test rolling method to verify and optimize the rationality of the design and process, and the design and process will be modified if they are not appropriate. This mode has a long production cycle, which is not conducive to the large-scale production of tube and is not in line with the current development trend of green manufacturing and intelligent manufacturing. Computer-aided Technology can solve this problem, which includes CAD (Computer Aided Design), CAM(Computer Aided Manufacturing), CAE (Computer Aided Engineering), and CAPP (Computer Aided Process Planning) and so on. Computer-aided technology can help technicians to optimize various aspects of theoretical design, process and manufacturing. CAE can verify the rationality of CAD, then CAD and CAM are linked again by CAPP, so the theoretical design and simulation manufacturing and product inspection can form a closed loop, which can effectively improve the efficiency of scientific equipment design and process design of the large-scale tube rolling production, thus accelerating the product manufacturing cycle and reducing production costs. At present, Computer-aided Technology has been widely used in the field of tube rolling, and the product quality has been improved, laying a foundation for the traditional tube rolling field to improve towards green manufacturing and intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: Research on the Role of Pronunciation laws in Chinese Named Entity Recognition(NER)
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: Named entity recognition is the basic task of natural language processing. It is widely used in information extraction and knowledge map construction. According to the unique pronunciation characteristics of Chinese, the word vector is trained by international phonetic alphabet, Pinyin and dialect phonetic alphabet. The word vector has the ability to represent the position and direction of the context. In the experiment, the word vector is embedded in the model constructed based on transformer. Through the comparative experiment, the experiment is embedded in the resume data set and Weibo data set. Compared with the other three models as the baseline, the F1 value is the highest after embedding the pronunciation regular word vector. The quantitative and qualitative analysis is carried out on the recognition results of the test set to further verify the effectiveness of Chinese pronunciation law in improving the performance of Chinese named entity recognition.

articleTitle: Target-Before-Detect Algorithm for Passive MIMO Radar Based on Improved Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2022 Global Conference on Robotics, Artificial Intelligence and Information Technology (GCRAIT)
abstract: In order to improve the target detection performance of passive multiple-input-multiple-output (PMR) radar system, a Target-Before-Detect (TBD) algorithm based on improved particle filter is proposed in this paper. As a classical TBD algorithm, particle filter algorithm can realize the gain accumulation of target signal in time domain and effectively improve the performance of target detection. Although this algorithm has performed well in passive single-input-single-output (SISO) radar (PSR) systems, it cannot be directly applied to PMR systems. Therefore, an improved particle filtering algorithm based on passive MIMO radar is proposed in this paper. This method takes advantage of the PMR spatial accumulation and proposes a novel particle weight calculation method, which uses the false alarm probability distribution of detector to calculate the weight of the particle, so as to obtain the gain accumulation of the target in time and space. The simulation results show that the detection probability of the proposed algorithm can reach 90% even when the target-path signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is low. Meanwhile, the good detection performance of the proposed algorithm is verified by comparing with the single frame detection results.
